favicon.empty: Without one the storefront shows its default icon.

store.regionHint: How dates and product measurements are kept.
store.unitsHint: Product forms open in these units. Saved products are not converted.

contact.title: Contact details
contact.description: How customers reach you; each is written here only. The {telefon}, {e_posta}, {adres} and {whatsapp} details in texts show them too.
contact.contact_emailHint: Shown in the storefront's footer, on the contact page, in the legal texts and in e-mails.
contact.contact_phoneHint: Shown in the footer, on the contact page, in the legal texts and in the structured data given to Google. No need to add +90.
contact.whatsapp_phoneHint: The storefront's WhatsApp buttons open this number. Leave it empty and no button shows.
contact.map_urlHint: A link on the contact page that opens the map. In Google Maps, find your shop and use Share > Copy link.
contact.addressHint: Shown in the footer, on the contact page, in the legal texts and in the structured data given to Google; the law asks for it in full.

hours.midnightHint: Open until midnight? Enter 00:00 as the closing time.

errors.overlap: This range overlaps another one on the same day.

reasons.reserved_root: {{names}}: this address is kept for the shop's own pages.

searchConsole.title: Search Console
searchConsole.description: The shop's Google Search Console property. Every night the sitemap is submitted, the pages' clicks and impressions read, and pages inspected for the index; the SEO page and the audit show the results.

searchConsole.notGranted: The Google account was connected without Search Console. Connect it again for Search Console.
searchConsole.noSites: The connected Google account reads no Search Console property. Add the shop's domain to Search Console and verify it.

shareImage.title: Share image
shareImage.hint: Shown when a link to a page without its own image is shared on WhatsApp, Instagram or X.
shareImage.size: 1200×630 pixels recommended; your logo and shop name in the middle, with space at the edges.

home.title: Home page
home.hint: Your shop's home page shows with this title and description in search results and when shared.
home.pageTitleHint: When empty, your shop's name is used. Search results show about 60 characters.
home.descriptionHint: When empty, no description is written and search engines pick a passage from the page. About 155 characters show.

features.title: Features
features.subtitle: Features you can turn on or off for your shop.
features.empty: No features to switch yet. Features such as cash on delivery will show up here as they arrive.
features.locked: Comes with your plan; cannot be changed here.
features.requires: Works only while “{{name}}” is on too.

catalog.title: Catalog and products
catalog.description: Product kinds, dated products and parts of the product page.

customers.title: Customers and marketing
customers.description: Wholesalers and bulk messages to consented customers.

seo.title: Search engines (SEO)
seo.description: Publishing checks and notices to search engines.

sales.title: Sales and payment
sales.description: Ways to pay, gift cards and selling past stock.

restricted.title: Age-restricted products
restricted.description: Marking adults-only products and asking for age at checkout.

ai.title: AI
ai.description: Your own service key and tasks on what customers write.

other.title: Other
other.description: Features not yet placed in a group.

reviews.label: AI on reviews and questions
reviews.summary: Sums up reviews and drafts replies to reviews and questions.
reviews.description: Product reviews are summed up; replies to reviews and questions are drafted. What customers wrote goes to the connected service without the author's name and contact details.

own_keys.label: Your own AI key
own_keys.summary: AI services are connected with the shop's own key.
own_keys.description: AI services are connected with the key of the shop's own account; the service bills the shop directly. Connections are under Settings > AI.

storefront_search.label: Search in your own words
storefront_search.summary: Shoppers can search the storefront in their own words.
storefront_search.description: Shoppers type what they look for as a sentence (e.g. "camping knife under 500 lira"); the shop's own AI key reads it into the search's filters. What the shopper typed goes to the connected service.

non_physical.label: Digital and service products
non_physical.summary: Products with no shipping: e-books, gift codes, courses, services.
non_physical.description: Sell products that need no shipping (e-books, gift codes, courses, services); they ask for no shipping or measurements.

restricted.label: Restricted products
restricted.summary: Products and categories can be marked adults only.
restricted.description: Products and categories can be marked adults only (weapons and blades, alcohol, tobacco, adult content). Marked products are told to search engines as adult-oriented and stay out of the product feeds.

addons.label: Product add-ons
addons.summary: Products can offer paid or free add-ons.
addons.description: Products may offer paid add-ons: a typed text or a choice, priced on the server and added to the line's price. They are set on the product page's Add-ons card.

booking.label: Dated products
booking.summary: Services with departure dates and places: tours, events, courses.
booking.description: Sell services with departure dates (tours, events, courses, workshops): each departure has its own places, held in the cart for a while. Digital and service products must be on too.

product_videos.label: Product videos
product_videos.summary: Uploaded videos and YouTube links on product pages.
product_videos.description: Product pages show the videos the shop uploads and YouTube links. Uploads count toward the plan's storage limit.

campaigns.label: Bulk e-mail and SMS
campaigns.summary: Bulk e-mail and SMS to consented customers from the panel.
campaigns.description: Bulk e-mail and SMS campaigns to consented customers from the panel.

indexnow.label: Announce changed pages with IndexNow
indexnow.summary: Changed pages are announced to Bing and Yandex at once.
indexnow.description: When a product, category or brand page is added, changed or removed, Bing, Yandex and other IndexNow search engines are told. Needs the shop's main domain; Google does not take part.

publish_gate.label: SEO publish gate
publish_gate.summary: A product with a critical gap or a low score cannot go live.
publish_gate.description: A product with a critical gap (no price or image) or an SEO score under 50 cannot go live. When off, the advisor only suggests.

preorder.label: Selling past stock (preorder)
preorder.summary: A variant out of stock keeps selling as a preorder.
preorder.description: A variant whose stock runs out can still be sold, as a preorder or shipped from a supplier. Turned on per variant on the product page; search engines are told it is on backorder.

gift_cards.label: Gift cards and store credit
gift_cards.summary: Give gift cards; put refunds and goodwill amounts on account.
gift_cards.description: Gift cards can be made and given to customers, who use the code in their basket and keep what is left for later. Store credit takes refunds or goodwill amounts onto an account.

cash_on_delivery.label: Cash on delivery
cash_on_delivery.summary: Shoppers pay the courier on delivery.
cash_on_delivery.description: Shoppers can pay the courier on delivery. The fee, the limit and the couriers that collect are under Settings > Payment > Cash on delivery.

age_verification.label: Age verification
age_verification.summary: A cart with an adults-only product asks for age before paying.
age_verification.description: When a cart holds an adults-only product, the shopper declares their age with their date of birth before paying; under the limit, no payment is taken. The date of birth is not kept. The limit is in Settings > Legal texts.

payment_links.label: Orders by payment link
payment_links.summary: The team prepares the order; the customer pays by link.
payment_links.description: The team prepares an order in the panel; the customer pays through a payment link on the storefront.

wholesale.label: Wholesale customers
wholesale.summary: Wholesalers see their own prices before VAT and order.
wholesale.description: Wholesalers are opened from the panel; signed in, they see products at their level’s or their own prices, without KDV, and order. Public prices do not change. Turned off, wholesalers see retail prices; their records and prices are kept.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.subtitle: Long tasks such as exports. Files are kept for a week.
jobs.empty: No jobs yet. They show up here when you start an export.
jobs.cancelHint: A queued job never starts; a running one stops at its next step. What it did by then (rows imported, say) stays.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Who changed what, and who looked at personal data. Opening this page is recorded too.
audit.exportStarted: Export started. Download the file from Jobs when it is ready.
audit.retention: Exported files are kept on the Jobs page for a week.
audit.exportFiltered: Export the filtered entries as CSV

filters.rangeHint: Turkey time; either end may stay empty.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Where you keep your stock. New products' stock and the Stock page use the default location; orders reserve stock at the locations linked to your sales channel.
locations.noAddress: No address yet; shipping and returns will need one.
locations.deleteDescription: The location leaves the list. One that holds, reserves or awaits stock is not deleted.

form.description: The location's name and full address. Shipping and returns will use this address.
form.name: Location name
form.nameHint: For example Main Warehouse, Kadıköy Store.
form.nameTooLong: The location's name can be at most 100 characters.
form.foreign: This location's address is abroad; only its name can be changed here.

lowStock.label: Shop threshold (units)

payments.subtitle: How your customers pay. Each method is connected and set up on its own page.

card.title: Card payments
card.description: Card and installment payments are taken on the provider's secure payment page; card details never reach your shop.

other.title: Other payment methods
other.description: Ways besides cards you can offer your customers.

iyzico.description: Credit and debit cards, in one payment or in installments.

bank_transfer.name: Bank transfer
bank_transfer.description: The customer sends the amount to your bank account; you confirm the order once it arrives.

cash_on_delivery.name: Cash on delivery
cash_on_delivery.description: The customer pays on delivery; you can add a fee and an amount limit.

account.description: In the PayTR Merchant Panel under Support & Setup > Integration Details, below "API Integration Details". The merchant key and salt are stored encrypted and never shown again once saved.

iyzico.testModeHint: While on, no real money is taken. Sandbox and live keys differ; enter both again when you switch.
iyzico.sandboxKeyLive: This is a sandbox key. Enter the live key or keep the sandbox on.

returns.packageTravelHint: When on, a dated product cancelled 30 days or more before its day keeps nothing (whatever its cancellation terms say); the shopper is told the refund comes within 14 days.

bookingFlow.voucherNote: Note in the e-mail instead of the voucher

bookingFlow.noteInvalid: The note must be one line, without invisible characters.

suppressions.removed: Address taken off the list; messages may go to it again.

domain.description: Have e-mail go from your shop's own domain. Until it is verified, e-mail goes from the platform's address under your shop's name; customers' replies reach your contact e-mail.

domain.name: Domain

domain.notYet: The records are not visible yet; try again a little later.

dns.selector: Signing key found under the "{{selector}}" selector.

hints.spf: Says which servers may send e-mail for your domain.

alerts.title: Shop alerts
alerts.description: Which of the bell's alerts also come by e-mail. The bell shows them all anyway.
alerts.emailsHint: Up to 5 addresses, one per line or comma-separated. Left empty, alerts show in the panel only.

alert_new_order.hint: Every time an order is placed, and when a paid order is placed short of stock.

alert_bank_transfer.title: Bank transfer awaited
alert_bank_transfer.hint: Orders paid by bank transfer waiting for the money to be confirmed.

alert_low_stock.title: Low stock

kindHint.transactional: Needs no consent: the order or the account calls for it.
kindHint.commercial: Goes only to recipients who consented on that channel.

emailLimit.description: The most e-mails the shop sends in a day. Marketing e-mails and order or account e-mails are counted apart, each up to this limit: a campaign never stops an order's e-mail. Orders placed with made-up addresses bounce and hurt the sender's reputation; at 80% of the limit the bell warns you, and past it no more e-mails of that kind go out that day.
emailLimit.label: At most a day

customer.title: Customer messages
customer.description: The texts of the messages your customers get. Click a row to change the subject, text and SMS, or turn optional messages off; the layout and legal parts stay fixed.

kind.transactional: Transactional message: needs no consent, sent because of the order or account.
kind.commercial: Commercial message: goes only to customers who consented.

customer.sendHint: Turned off, customers do not get this message.

requiredHint.default: This message is required; it cannot be turned off, only reworded.

order.placed: Required: the order's confirmation and distance-sales information must reach the customer on a durable medium (Law 6502 art. 48, Distance Contracts Regulation). You can reword it, not turn it off.
order.invoiced: Required: an online sale's e-Arşiv invoice must reach the buyer electronically (Tax Procedure Law General Communiqué 509).
order.access_link: Required: the customer asked for this link; a guest reaches their order no other way.

payment_link.sent: Required: the customer asked for the payment link and it reaches them no other way.

gift_card.issued: Required: the gift card's code is what was bought; this message delivers it.

return.approved: Required: the customer sends the goods back with the carrier code in this message (right of withdrawal).
return.refused: Required: the customer must be told which goods were not accepted and what they can do.

account.password_reset: Required: the password reset link goes only with this message.
account.verify_email: Required: the e-mail verification code goes only with this message.

consent.confirm: Required and fixed: confirming campaign consent (double opt-in) is the İYS record's proof; its text cannot be changed.

stock.alert_confirm: Required: the customer asked for the stock alert and gets nothing until they confirm.

booking.confirmed: Required: the departure details, cancellation terms and voucher reach the customer only through this message.
booking.cancelled: Required: the customer learns of the cancellation and the refund through this message.
booking.departure_cancelled: Required: the shop cancelled the departure; the customer learns of it and the full refund only through this message.

customer.marketingOn: Abandoned cart reminders are on. They are turned on and off in Marketing settings.
customer.marketingOff: Abandoned cart reminders are off. They are turned on and off in Marketing settings.

fieldHints.preheader: The short text shown next to the subject in the inbox.
fieldHints.intro: The e-mail's first paragraph; line breaks are kept. Items, amounts and links follow it on their own.

customer.unknownTokens: Not a detail of this message: {{tokens}}. Add details from the menu at the field's right.
customer.smsCount: {{chars}} characters with each detail at its longest · {{parts}} SMS ({{perPart}} characters per SMS)
customer.smsLong: The text goes as {{parts}} SMS and each part is charged.
customer.smsTooLong: The text can be at most {{max}} SMS; shorten it.
customer.smsUcs2: A character outside the Turkish alphabet (an emoji, say) is in it; only 70 characters fit an SMS.
customer.previewHeld: The text has an unknown detail or too long an SMS; the preview shows the last valid text.
customer.fixedText: This message's text is fixed. Below is what the customer sees.
customer.missingTokens: This text must contain {{tokens}}: the customer reaches the link only through it.
customer.mayBeEmpty: {{tokens}} is empty in some sends (no sender or tracking yet); the text should read well without it.
customer.smsUcs2Risk: If a detail a customer typed (a name) has letters outside the Turkish alphabet (â, î, û), the SMS splits into 70-character parts.

smtp.rejected: The mail server no longer accepts the saved details. Enter the password again and save.

checks.merchant_invalid: No secure connection could be made. Check the security choice and that the server name matches its certificate.
checks.secret_invalid: The mail server did not accept this user name and password.

smtp.dialogDescription: Enter the SMTP details of the e-mail account in your server's panel. Saving connects and signs in to the server; no e-mail is sent.
smtp.removeDescription: E-mails go through the platform's sending service again. The saved password is deleted.
smtp.hostHint: For example mail.shop.com. It must match the name on the certificate.

smtp.fromEmailHint: E-mails go from this address; the server must allow it for this account.
smtp.fromNameHint: Leave empty to show your shop's name.
smtp.rate: Campaign e-mails per minute at most
smtp.rateHint: Bulk sends go at this pace so your server's address is not listed as spam. Order and account e-mails do not wait.
smtp.hostInvalid: Type the server's full name (e.g. mail.shop.com), localhost or an IP address.
smtp.usernameInvalid: The user name must be one line.
smtp.fromEmailInvalid: Type the sender as an e-mail address.
smtp.fromNameInvalid: The sender name must be one line.
smtp.plainRemote: An unencrypted connection is only made to a server on the same machine; choose STARTTLS or SSL/TLS.

test.sent: A test e-mail went to {{to}}. Check your inbox (and spam folder).

reasons.tls_failed: No secure connection could be made. Check the security choice and that the server name matches its certificate.
reasons.aborted: The server did not answer within 20 seconds.
reasons.deferred: The server did not take the e-mail for now (temporary error). Try again shortly.
reasons.recipient_rejected: The server refused the recipient: there is no mailbox at this address.
reasons.rejected: The server refused the e-mail. Check that the sender address belongs to this account.
reasons.outcome_unknown: The connection broke while sending; the e-mail may have gone. Check your inbox.

reasons.failed: The server gave an unexpected answer.

sms.providersDescription: Connect the service texts go through. Without a connected account no text goes; e-mails still do.

netgsm.description: Texts from the shop's own Netgsm account, under your approved header. Campaign texts are checked against İYS.

keys.title: SMS account
keys.description: The user code and password Netgsm gives. Turn on API access under Settings > API in the Netgsm panel; the server's IP may need allowing.

netgsm.msgheaderHint: Type your approved Netgsm header exactly (2–11 characters). Texts go out under it.

netgsm.iysBrandCodeHint: The number İYS gave your brand (digits only). Left empty, consents are not sent to İYS and wait.

limit.title: Daily SMS limit
limit.description: The most texts the shop sends a day. A guard on cost and abuse: at 80% the panel's bell warns, at the limit no text goes until the next day. Each number also has an hourly (5) and a daily (10) limit.
limit.label: Texts a day at most

iysCard.title: İYS upload
iysCard.description: How the commercial message consents are reaching İYS. They are sent every 10 minutes.
iysCard.noBrandCode: No İYS brand code yet; consents wait to be sent. Add it on the Netgsm account page.

optOut.title: Opt-out line

optOut.hint: At most {{max}} characters. Type the opt-out line your SMS service (Netgsm, İYS) gave you exactly. Left empty, no bulk SMS can be sent.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.description: Consented messages and product lists that bring shoppers in.

abandonedCart.title: Abandoned cart reminder
abandonedCart.description: A shopper who leaves items in the cart gets one e-mail. Only addresses with e-mail consent get it; its link opens the cart once and lasts 7 days.
abandonedCart.enabledHint: The shop's domain and e-mail sender must be set up.
abandonedCart.delay: Send once the cart is unchanged for

feeds.title: Product feeds
feeds.description: Your product list for Google Merchant Center, the Meta (Facebook, Instagram) catalog, Cimri and Akakçe. Prices, stock and codes come from the same source as the product pages and are refreshed every two hours; products out of stock or without an image are left out.
feeds.off: Feeds are off. Turning them on makes an address to give each site.
feeds.building: The first feed is being built; it appears here in a few minutes.

issue.title: Renew the address?
issue.description: The old addresses stop working at once. Replace them in Google Merchant Center, Meta, Cimri and Akakçe with the new ones.

off.title: Turn the feeds off?
off.description: The addresses and the built files are removed; these sites can no longer fetch your products this way.

feeds.noDomain: The shop has no domain yet; feeds link to product pages, so they cannot be built. Enter the domain under Settings > SEO.

feedRules.title: Feed rules
feedRules.description: Which categories each feed leaves out. Shipping comes from your shipping settings (the desi table or a flat rate, with the free shipping threshold); handling time and the same-day dispatch hour Akakçe shows from Shipping and delivery > Options and rates > Delivery time.
feedRules.exclusionsHint: Products in the categories you tick, and in every category under them, stay out of the {{target}} feed.
feedRules.saved: Feed rules saved; the feeds follow them from their next refresh.

google.title: Google Merchant Center
google.description: Your products are sent to your Merchant Center account through Merchant API so they show on Google Shopping: only what changed, every two hours. It can replace the feed address or run beside it.
google.notConnected: Connect with the Google account that reaches your Merchant Center. You allow it on Google's own screen; your password is not shared with us.
google.merchantIdHint: The number under your account name at the top right of Merchant Center. It is checked with Google as you save.
google.syncError: The last run {{when}} stopped; check the Google connection and your access to the account.

confirm.title: Disconnect Google?
confirm.description: Access ends at Google too, products are no longer sent and the Google reviews leave the storefront. The products in Merchant Center stay there until you remove them or they lapse.

outcome.denied: Access was not allowed on Google; nothing was connected.
outcome.state_invalid: The connection request expired; try again.
outcome.no_refresh_token: Google gave no lasting access; try again.
outcome.restricted: Your shop is restricted, so Google was not connected. See Settings > Subscription.
outcome.failed: Google could not be connected; try again.

conversions.title: Conversion measurement
conversions.description: Orders are told to ad and analytics tools from the server, so browser blockers do not skew the counts. Each event goes with the consent the shopper gave in the cookie banner: Meta needs marketing consent, GA4 analytics consent.

meta.name: Meta (Facebook, Instagram)
meta.description: Orders are told to your Meta pixel through the Conversions API; the browser pixel's event for the same order counts once.

ga4.name: Google Analytics 4
ga4.description: Orders and refunds are told to your GA4 web stream through the Measurement Protocol.

keys.title: Pixel and access token
keys.description: Take the pixel id from Meta Events Manager > Data sources > your pixel > Settings; create a Conversions API access token on the same page.

meta.testEventCodeHint: The code from Events Manager > Test events; clear it once you are done. Empty, events count for real.

checks.merchant_invalid: Meta does not know this pixel, or the token cannot reach it.
checks.secret_invalid: Meta did not accept this access token.

meta.rejected: Meta no longer accepts the stored token; events cannot be sent. Enter a new one.

keys.title: Web stream
keys.description: Google Analytics > Admin > Data streams > your web stream: take the measurement id, and create a key under Measurement Protocol API secrets.

ga4.measurementIdHint: The id starting with G-, such as G-ABC123XYZ.

checks.merchant_invalid: GA4 does not know this measurement id.
checks.secret_invalid: GA4 did not accept this secret.

ga4.rejected: GA4 no longer accepts the stored secret. Enter a new one.

bulk.description: Limits for the e-mail and SMS campaigns sent from Growth > Bulk messages.

bulk.hoursHint: Bulk texts go only within these hours (Türkiye time). A send outside them waits and goes on by itself when they open.

package.title: Monthly accounting package

package.later: The package is being made; download it from Settings > Jobs when it is done.
package.failed: The package could not be made.

dialog.copyFailed: Could not copy; select the password and copy it yourself.

migration.title: Migration

descriptions.plannedDocuments_other: {{formatted}} products' descriptions will move with their formatting

photo.description: Pick a product photo; AI suggests a name, short description, category and attributes. Price and stock are never suggested.
photo.uploadFailed: The photo could not be uploaded.
photo.note: The photo is sent to {{name}} for the suggestion. Keep in mind if it shows a person. The photo becomes the first picture of the product.
photo.used: The form was filled. Review it before saving.

hint.text: Connect an AI service to fill the product form from a photo.
hint.ownerOnly: With an AI service connected the product form can be filled from a photo; the store owner can connect one.

detail.title: Product
detail.handleHint: If you change a published product's address, the old one is kept and not given to another product.
detail.shippingHint: Optional. These apply to variants without their own values; with none, shipping is priced by the default parcel.
detail.unpublished: Product unpublished and moved to drafts.
detail.deleteDescription: The product, its variants and stock records are deleted. This cannot be undone.
detail.variantsNoLocation: The shop has no default location; add one before entering stock.
detail.costHint: Unit cost, VAT excluded; used in reports only, never shown to customers.

codes.hint: Google Shopping recognises a product by its barcode (GTIN); without one, the brand with the manufacturer part number (MPN) will do. All may be left empty.

stored.format: This code is not a GTIN barcode; Google does not recognise the product by it.
stored.check: The barcode's last digit does not fit; Google does not use it.

detail.descriptionHint: Write with headings, lists, quotes and tables. Search engines favour at least {{suggested}} words.
detail.shortDescriptionHint: Shows as written under the product name, above the price. Optional, at most 1,500 characters. Without an SEO description of its own, the search result’s description is taken from it too.
detail.shortDescriptionPlaceholder: E.g. Introduce the product in a few sentences: material, size, use.
detail.previewReady: The preview opened in a new tab and its link was copied. It works for 24 hours or until the product is saved again.
detail.aiTitle: Suggest a product name with AI
detail.aiShortDescription: Suggest a short description with AI

sections.defaultParcel: Not entered; the default parcel is used
sections.struck: The discount is shown struck through
sections.blocked: The discount is not shown struck through
sections.blockedIn_one: Discount not struck through on {{count}} variant
sections.blockedIn_other: Discount not struck through on {{count}} variants

catalog.hint: Used in search results and product feeds.
catalog.primaryCategoryHint: One of the product's categories; the page's breadcrumb follows it.
catalog.kindHint: Digital and service products need no shipping or measurements.
catalog.withdrawalExcludedHint: On a physical product it is the sealed-goods warning (MSY art. 15/1-ç): the return can be requested, and one that arrives with its protective seal opened is refused at receipt. A digital product or a service stays outside the right outright (art. 15/1-ğ, h). For a made-to-order good (art. 15/1-b), mark its add-on "Outside the right of withdrawal".
catalog.giftCardHint: Its variants are the card's amounts. Once paid, a card is issued for each unit and e-mailed to the recipient. The product becomes digital, with no shipping; turning off stock tracking on its variants is recommended.
catalog.kindGiftCard: A gift card is a digital product; its kind cannot change.

booking.title: Dates and capacity
booking.description: Each departure has its own capacity; places sold and held in carts are tracked here.
booking.empty: No departures yet. Add a single departure or create repeating ones.
booking.zoneNote: Times are in the product's time zone ({{zone}}).
booking.capacityHint: The most places (people) this departure can sell.

mode.label: Dated sale (departures)
mode.hint: Services that start at a set date and time: tours, events, workshops. Each departure has its own capacity; stock tracking is turned off on the variants. Default: off.

off.title: Turn off dated sale?
off.description: The product sells without choosing a departure, through the ordinary cart. Existing departures and bookings are not deleted.
off.stock: Stock tracking does not come back on by itself; the product can sell without limit. Turn stock tracking on in the variants if needed.
off.taken_one: Upcoming departures have {{count}} place sold or held in carts.
off.taken_other: Upcoming departures have {{count}} places sold or held in carts.

recurring.title: Repeating departures
recurring.capacityHint: Each departure gets the same capacity; change any of them later.
recurring.preview_other: {{count}} departures will be added: first {{first}}, last {{last}}.
recurring.previewNone: No departure matches. Choose the days and the date range.
recurring.more: At most {{max}} departures are added at once; add the rest of the range afterwards.

edit.title: Edit departure
edit.capacityHint_one: Cannot go below the {{count}} place sold and held in carts.
edit.capacityHint_other: Cannot go below the {{count}} places sold and held in carts.
edit.pricesHint: An amount added to the variant's price for this departure (TRY). Write a minus for a discount (e.g. -150). A variant left empty sells at its usual price; line prices are always worked out on the server.

cancel.title: Cancel the departure?
cancel.description: The {{start}} departure is taken off sale at once, no longer listed on the storefront, and every confirmed booking is refunded in full.
cancel.loading: Working out the bookings it touches…
cancel.previewFailed: The bookings it touches could not be read. Cancelling still refunds every booking in full.
cancel.refundAtLeast: Refund in all at least {{amount}} (some bookings could not be worked out; all are refunded in full)
cancel.after: Refunds and cancels run in the background after you confirm; any that fail are tried again.
cancel.noBookings: This departure has no confirmed bookings.
cancel.byHand_one: To refund by hand: {{amount}} ({{count}} order; bank transfer, cash on delivery or gift card). The places go back; you send the money.
cancel.byHand_other: To refund by hand: {{amount}} ({{count}} orders; bank transfer, cash on delivery or gift card). The places go back; you send the money.

bookings.title: Participants
bookings.empty: No bookings on this departure yet.

settings.title: Booking settings
settings.cutoff_hoursHint: How many hours before the departure sales close. 0: open until it starts.
settings.hold_minutesHint: How many minutes a cart holds places before payment (10–60). Default: 20.
settings.max_units_per_cartHint: The most places one cart can take on this product. Default: 20.
settings.min_participantsHint: For information; sales do not depend on it.
settings.paxHint: How many places each variant takes and its ages. An infant may take 0, a family ticket 4; default 1.
settings.travelerLevelHint: Asked for each traveler at checkout. An ID or passport number is kept encrypted and shown masked in the panel. Ask only what you need (KVKK).
settings.saleModeHint: Call me: the storefront shows a request form instead of add to cart; no payment is taken and no places are held. Requests appear under Customers > Contact messages.

travelerLevels.none: Don't ask (I'll collect them myself later)
travelerLevels.name: Name
travelerLevels.nationality: Name, birth date, ID/passport no, nationality

tiers.title: Customer cancellation
tiers.hint: What is kept when the customer cancels from their account, by days left to the departure. The days left fall to the best matching row; below every row the row with the fewest days applies.
tiers.empty: With no rows the customer cannot cancel themselves; you can always cancel from the order.
tiers.packageFree: Package travel: 30 days or more before, nothing is kept (0% applies).
tiers.noDayZero: Cancels fewer than {{days}} days before the departure also keep this row's share ({{percent}}%). Add a 0-day row for a rule of their own for the last days.

settings.reminder_daysHint: A reminder e-mail goes to the customer this many days before the departure. 0: none.

errors.disabled: For dated products, first turn on both dated products and digital and service products in Settings > Features.
errors.kind: A dated product can only be a service; turn off dated sale before changing its kind.
errors.range: Selling by date range (stays, rentals) is not available yet.
errors.notDated: This product is not sold by date; turn on dated sale in its catalog details first.
errors.capacityBelowSold: Capacity cannot go below the places sold and held in carts.
errors.dates: The end must be after the start.
errors.slotUnknown: Departure not found; the list was refreshed.
errors.variantUnknown: A variant given a price difference is not this product's.
errors.priceAdjustment: A price difference can be at most 1,000,000 TRY, to the kuruş.
errors.holdMinutes: The hold must be between 10 and 60 minutes.
errors.paxAges: The minimum age cannot be above the maximum age.
errors.pax: Kinds of person can be set for at most 100 variants.

form.capacity: Capacity must be a whole number between 1 and 10,000.
form.start: Enter the start date and time.
form.past: The departure must be in the future.
form.range: The last day cannot be before the first.
form.noStarts: No future departure falls on those days in that range.
form.adjustment: Write the price difference in TRY (e.g. 250.50 or -150).
form.cutoff: Sales close must be between 0 and 1440 hours.
form.maxUnits: Most places per cart must be between 1 and 500.
form.minParticipants: Minimum participants must be between 1 and 10,000, or left empty.
form.pax: Places taken must be a whole number between 0 and 20.
form.tierDays: Days must be a whole number between 0 and 365.
form.tierPercent: The share must be a whole number between 0 and 100.
form.tierSame: Another row has this day count.
form.tierOrder: A row nearer the departure cannot keep less.
form.reminderDays: The reminder must be between 0 and 30 days (0: none).

errors.tiers: Cancellation tiers are invalid: each day count once, and nearer the departure never keeps less.
errors.slotCancelled: A cancelled departure cannot be opened again.
errors.useDepartureCancel: Use the cancel button to cancel a departure; its bookings are refunded.

addons.title: Add-ons
addons.description: A text or a choice the shopper picks with the variant. Its price is worked out on the server and added to the product's unit price.
addons.example: Example: Text on the product, +35 TL, up to 10 units, 50 characters, outside the right of withdrawal.
addons.discountNote: Campaign discounts apply to the add-on's price too.
addons.limit: A product can have up to {{max}} add-ons.
addons.flagOff: Add-ons are off: they are not shown in the store and cannot be changed here.
addons.removedNote: Shoppers who put a removed add-on in their cart will have to change their pick before paying.
addons.sheetHint: The shopper sees this field on the product page; its price is worked out on the server when it goes in the cart.
addons.savesAll: Saving saves all of the product's add-ons together.

kindHints.text: The shopper types a text, such as a name to put on the product.
kindHints.choice: The shopper picks one of the options; unless it is required, they may pick none.

addons.kindLocked: A saved add-on keeps its kind; add a new one for another kind.
addons.label: Name
addons.labelHint: Shown on the product page, in the cart and on the order; up to {{max}} characters.
addons.helpHint: Shown under the field; up to {{max}} characters.
addons.priceHint: Per unit, VAT included. Empty or 0 is free.
addons.maxQuantityHint: How many units a line can hold with this add-on; empty for no limit.
addons.charsetHint: Free text takes . , ' - & besides letters, digits and spaces. Links and e-mail addresses are never accepted.
addons.choicesHint: {{min}} to {{max}} options. Do not add a "none" option; picking nothing says that.
addons.requiredHint: Only a free add-on can be required: the price shown on the page, in feeds and in search results is the price without add-ons.
addons.nonWithdrawableHint: Made to the buyer's wish: a product bought with it is outside the right of withdrawal (MSY art. 15/1-b) and comes back only if faulty or wrong.

rules.letters_digits: Up to {{count}} characters, letters and digits

errors.disabled: Add-ons are off. Turn them on in Settings > Features.
errors.requiredFree: A paid add-on cannot be required. Set its price to 0 or make it optional.
errors.tooMany: A product can have up to 5 add-ons.
errors.label: A name is 1-60 characters, without invisible characters.
errors.help: A description is up to 160 characters, without invisible characters.
errors.price: A price is between 0 and 10,000 TL, with at most two decimals.
errors.maxQuantity: The limit per line is a whole number between 1 and 99, or empty.
errors.maxLength: The character limit is a whole number between 1 and 200.
errors.idDuplicate: The same add-on was sent twice. Reload the page and try again.

copy.title: Copy from another product
copy.description: The chosen product's add-ons are copied to this product with their names, prices and rules.
copy.replaceText: This product's {{current}} add-ons are removed and {{name}}'s {{copied}} add-ons take their place. Shoppers holding a removed add-on in their cart must change their choice before paying.

sheets.exportStarted: The product list is being prepared; download it when it is ready.
sheets.exportFailed: The product list could not be prepared.
sheets.importHint: Excel (xlsx) or CSV, 5,000 rows at most. The file is checked first; you see what it would do, then confirm.
sheets.templateHint: An empty sheet with your shop's columns; its second sheet explains each. An exported list can be edited and uploaded too.
sheets.problems_one: {{count}} row has a problem; its product is skipped.
sheets.problems_other: {{count}} rows have problems; their products are skipped.
sheets.seoTitle: SEO preview of the new products
sheets.nothing: No product to apply; the report shows the rows with problems.
sheets.jobFailed: The file could not be processed.
sheets.limited_one: {{count}} new product was not added: your package's product limit is reached. The report lists it.
sheets.limited_other: {{count}} new products were not added: your package's product limit is reached. The report lists them.

bulk.tooMany: At most {{max}} products can be edited at once; narrow the search or view.
bulk.scope_one: Applies to the {{formatted}} selected product. Each product is checked as if saved on its own; those that do not fit are listed in the report.
bulk.scope_other: Applies to the {{formatted}} selected products. Each product is checked as if saved on its own; those that do not fit are listed in the report.
bulk.background: The bulk edit goes on in the background; follow it under Settings › Jobs.
bulk.jobFailed: The bulk edit could not finish.
bulk.left_one: {{formatted}} product was skipped or could not be saved; see the report for why.
bulk.left_other: {{formatted}} products were skipped or could not be saved; see the report for why.

price.hint: The variants' TRY price changes; other currencies and price lists stay as they are.

stock.hint: The quantity at the default warehouse changes; products whose stock is not tracked are skipped. Recorded in the stock history as a bulk edit.

hints.published: Physical products missing measurements, and those the SEO publish gate holds back when it is on, are not published; the report lists them.
hints.draft: The products leave the shop; their pages do not open until they are published again.

hints.add: The products are added to this category too; their other categories stay.
hints.remove: The products leave this category; if it was their primary one, the primary category is cleared.
hints.primary: The category becomes the products' primary one (added first if needed); the category path search engines see comes from it.

seo.label: Fields to give back to the template
seo.title: SEO title
seo.hint: Text written for each product is removed; the shop's SEO template is used (Settings › SEO).

alt.hint: Images without alt text get one from the product's name; an image of one variant gets that variant's values too (e.g. “Linen Shirt – White”). Alt texts already written are left alone.

errors.rise: Enter a rate above zero, 1000 at most.
errors.fall: Enter a rate above zero, 99 at most.
errors.quantity: Enter zero or a positive whole number.
errors.adjust: Enter a whole number above zero.

hints.set: Every variant of the selected products gets the same cost.
hints.percent: Only variants with a cost change.

cost.clearHint: The selected products' variants lose their cost; they leave the stock value.

priceHistory.title: Price history
priceHistory.hint: The selling price and the price without a sale over the last 90 days. The price struck through in the shop is the lowest of the {{days}} days before a discount; an automatic campaign everyone gets is part of the price.
priceHistory.unpriced: This variant has no Turkish lira price.
priceHistory.struck: The discount is shown struck through
priceHistory.struckDetail: The shop shows {{before}} struck through, with {{price}} beside it.
priceHistory.blocked: This discount is not shown struck through
priceHistory.blockedDetail: The lowest price in the {{days}} days before the discount was {{lowest}}. Today's {{price}} is not below it, so the shop does not show it as a discount.
priceHistory.regularBasis: The price history begins after the discount did, so the price without a sale is used.
priceHistory.unchanged: The price has not changed in the last 90 days.

side.organizeHint: The categories the product is listed in, its brand and its VAT rate.

variant.title: Edit variant
variant.listHint: Click a variant to edit its price, stock, codes and images.
variant.priceHint: VAT included; the storefront shows this price.
variant.applyAll_one: Apply this price to the other {{count}} variant too
variant.applyAll_other: Apply this price to the other {{count}} variants too
variant.stockHint: The quantity at the shop's default location.
variant.untracked: This variant's stock is not tracked.
variant.backorderHint: Orders are taken after it sells out too (preorder).
variant.measuresHint: This variant's own parcel. A measure left empty takes the product's parcel measure.
variant.picturesHint: Click the images to show when this variant is chosen. An image tied to no variant shows with all of them.
variant.noOwnPictures: No image is tied to this variant; the storefront shows all of the product's images.
variant.altAfterSave: You can add the images' alt texts once the product is saved.
variant.tabError: A field in this tab needs fixing

duplicate.done: {{title}} created and opened as a draft. SKU, barcode and stock were left empty.

filters.limited: This filter looks at the newest 5,000 products; older ones are not listed.

tags.hint: Group products and help search within the shop. A new tag is created when you save.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Add questions and answers in the shop's name to the product page's Q&A. They are published at once; you can hide them under Reviews and questions › Questions.
faq.empty: The AI suggests 3–5 questions and answers from the product's description, short description, attributes and options. No question is written that the data cannot answer.
faq.hint: Tick the ones to add; you can edit each question and answer before adding.
faq.question: Question
faq.added_one: The question was added to the product page.
faq.added_other: {{count}} questions were added to the product page.

issues.empty: The question and the answer cannot be empty.
issues.not_a_question: The question must end with a question mark.
issues.too_long: A question can be at most 120 characters, an answer at most 400.

sealedGoods.badge: Sealed good: not returnable once opened
sealedGoods.text: Returnable under the right of withdrawal while its protective seal is unopened; if it arrives opened, refuse it at receipt and it is not refunded (MSY art. 15/1-ç).

orders.description: Incoming orders; the ones to pack first
orders.empty: No orders yet. The first one will show up here.

ship.title: Ship #{{number}}?
ship.description: These items go into the parcel and the order becomes "Shipped".
ship.notify: Send the customer a shipping notice
ship.trackingHint: If you send the parcel yourself, type the carrier and the tracking number; the customer sees them on the order page and in the e-mail. A parcel sent with a carrier integration ignores these fields.
ship.trackingInvalid: Type the carrier and a 4–40 character tracking number.
ship.trackingUrlInvalid: The tracking link must be a web address (tracking.example.com/…).
ship.restTitle: Products in no parcel yet (in a parcel of their own)

deliver.title: Was the order delivered?
deliver.description: Parcels in transit are marked as delivered.

capture.title: Capture the payment?
capture.description: The amount authorized on the customer's card is transferred to your account.

cancel.title: Cancel #{{number}}?
cancel.description: The order is canceled and its reserved stock returns. This cannot be undone.

gift.issued: This order has gift cards. If none was used, canceling voids them (their balance set to zero) and refunds their money. Once one was spent or closed, the order cannot be canceled.
gift.pending: This order has gift cards that are not issued yet; if it is canceled, none will be.

cancel.giftUsed: The order could not be canceled: a gift card from it was spent or closed, and the cards belong to their recipient. Use a refund or a return request for the other items.

detail.title: Order
detail.credit: Paid with credit or gift card
detail.moneyFailed: The refundable amount could not be read.
detail.providerUnreachable: The payment provider could not be reached; card and installments show later.
detail.testPaid: This order was paid in test mode: no real money was taken. It ships only with a carrier in test mode, where no real courier comes.

fraudStatus.review: iyzico is reviewing it; do not ship before approval
fraudStatus.refused: iyzico refused it; the amount is refunded

bankTransfer.awaitingUntil: Order #{{number}} awaits its bank transfer until {{date}}; unpaid by then, it is cancelled.
bankTransfer.confirmDescription: Check that the amount is in your bank account. Once confirmed, the order counts as paid and can be shipped.
bankTransfer.confirmed: Transfer confirmed; the order can be shipped.

pickup.waiting_one: The parcel's label is ready. Print it and stick it on the parcel; the order moves to shipped by itself when the carrier picks it up.
pickup.waiting_other: Labels for {{count}} parcels are ready. Print them and stick them on the parcels; the order moves to shipped by itself when the carrier picks them up.
pickup.label: Download label

gift.pending: The card is issued and e-mailed to the recipient once payment is taken.

refund.title: Refund for #{{number}}
refund.description: Refund by choosing items or entering an amount. Up to {{refundable}} can be refunded.
refund.amountHint: The amount is spread over the items by what each was paid; at most {{refundable}}.
refund.noteHint: Optional; shown in the panel only.

settle.open: Check the incomplete refund at the provider
settle.title: Does the provider show this refund?
settle.question: The record of the {{amount}} refund could not be completed. Does the payment provider's panel show it refunded to the customer?
settle.hint: No money is sent from here. "Money went back" closes the record; "Money did not go back" fails it and its lines can be refunded again. Your choice is written to the audit log.

in_part.title: This refund was made in part
in_part.question: By iyzico's answers, {{done}} of the {{amount}} refund was given back; {{rest}} was not.
in_part.hint: No money is sent from here. Check in iyzico's panel that exactly {{done}} was given back for this refund. If it matches, the record closes at {{done}}; the remaining {{rest}} can be refunded again from the order's refund step by entering an amount. If it does not, leave the record open and write to iyzico's support team. Your choice is written to the audit log.
in_part.flow_owned: This refund belongs to the order's cancel or a return request; it cannot be closed in part here. Run the cancel or the return again and only the remaining {{rest}} is sent. If iyzico will not take the rest, refund it by hand in iyzico's panel and say so below: no money is sent from here, the record completes at {{amount}} and is written to the audit log.

lost.title: A part's answer was lost
lost.question: Does iyzico's panel show this {{part}} part refunded?
lost.hint: No money is sent from here. The record settles by your answer and the parts iyzico answered; any amount not given back can be refunded again. If you cannot see it in the panel, leave the record open and write to iyzico's support team. Your choice is written to the audit log.

settle.made_by_hand: I refunded the rest by hand in iyzico's panel

sure.made: Are you sure the money went back to the customer?
sure.not_made: Are you sure the money did not go back to the customer?
sure.made_in_part: Are you sure the record should close at {{done}}?
sure.made_by_hand: Are you sure the remaining {{rest}} was refunded to the customer by hand? No money is sent from here.
sure.lost_made: Are you sure the {{part}} part was refunded?
sure.lost_not_made: Are you sure the {{part}} part was not refunded?
sure.description: This choice settles the record and is written to the audit log. Confirm if you checked the provider's panel by the reference above.

done.not_made: The refund's record is closed; its lines can be refunded again.
done.made_in_part: The refund's record closed at {{done}}; the remaining {{rest}} can be refunded again.
done.made_by_hand: The refund's record completed at {{amount}}; no money was sent. You can run the cancel or the return again.

lost.done: The refund's record closed at what iyzico made; any rest can be refunded again.
lost.failed: The refund's record is closed; its lines can be refunded again.
lost.pending: The part's state is saved. Run the cancel or the return again and only the rest is sent.

chargeback.title: Chargeback for order #{{number}}
chargeback.description: Enter what the provider's notice says. The amount cannot exceed what was paid.
chargeback.amountInvalid: Enter the amount as a number.
chargeback.referenceHint: The dispute number in PayTR's or iyzico's notice.
chargeback.opened: Chargeback recorded; download the evidence and send it to the provider.
chargeback.alertDue: This order has a chargeback ({{status}}); evidence due {{date}}.
chargeback.queueDescription: Cardholders' disputes of payments; the nearest deadline first.

bulkShip.tooMany: At most {{max}} orders can be shipped at once.
bulkShip.label: Label
bulkShip.labelsMissing_one: {{count}} parcel's label could not be read; download it from its order page.
bulkShip.labelsMissing_other: {{count}} parcels' labels could not be read; download them from their order pages.

returns.queueDescription: Shoppers' return requests, those waiting for a decision first. Once approved the shopper hands the parcel over with the return code; receive it when it reaches the warehouse and its money goes back by itself.
returns.approved: Return approved; the shopper sees the return code.
returns.rejectDescription: The shopper reads this note on the request.
returns.receiveDescription: Enter how many came back sound and how many damaged; anything missing is left out. Sound ones go back in stock, damaged ones do not; both are refunded.
returns.refusedHint: For a sealed good, enter the units that arrived with their protective seal opened under "Opened": they do not go back in stock, are not refunded and are sent back to the shopper (MSY art. 15/1-ç).

refundShippingHints.law: Returning a product inside the right of withdrawal gives the order's shipping back by law (Distance Contracts Regulation art. 12/1); once per order.
refundShippingHints.choice: Only products outside the right of withdrawal came back; your call. Suggested when damaged, wrong or not as described.
refundShippingHints.none: Nothing is taken back; no money is refunded.

returns.refusedOnly: Received: the opened items were refused and nothing was refunded. Send them back to the shopper.

facts.canceledWithOrder: Closed because the order was cancelled

returns.label: Download return label
returns.empty: No return requests in this state.

exchange.approveDescription: The shopper sends the item with the return code; the new item is set aside from stock and ships once the return reaches the warehouse.
exchange.collectedHint: Tick it once paid by bank transfer or otherwise; the difference is recorded as paid on the order.
exchange.approved: Exchange approved; the shopper sees the return code.

card.title: Returns and exchanges
card.text: This order's return and exchange requests.
card.none: No return or exchange request on this order.

open.button: Open a return or exchange request
open.title: Open a return or exchange request
open.description: Opened for the shopper: the same rules apply, the shopper gets an e-mail and the request waits in the returns queue.
open.noVariant: This product has no other variant; it cannot be exchanged.
open.done: Request opened; the shopper was e-mailed.
open.excludedReason: One of the chosen products is outside the right of withdrawal; it comes back only as damaged, wrong or not as described.
open.excludedExchange: One of the chosen products is outside the right of withdrawal and cannot be exchanged. If it is faulty, open a return.
open.giftSeparate: Gift card lines are asked for in a request of their own, and only as money back.
open.giftUsed: A card of this gift card line has been spent, so its right of withdrawal is gone.

returns.refundFailed: The refund failed: {{reason}} Try again with "Try the refund again" in the actions menu.

gift.note: Gift card return: the cards are voided and the money is refunded at once; no parcel is waited for.
gift.title: Approve the gift card return of #{{number}}?
gift.description: Once approved, as many unused cards as asked are closed (their balance set to zero), the request counts as received and the money is refunded. This cannot be undone.
gift.refundFailed: The cards were voided but the refund failed: {{reason}} Try again with "Try the refund again" in the actions menu.

TITLE-01.title: The search result title is {{length}} characters; {{min}}–{{max}} is advised.
TITLE-01.why: A short title says little about the page; a long one is cut in search results. Turkish letters are wide, so the pixel width counts too.
TITLE-01.how: Edit the SEO title, or remove your own title to use the shop's title template.

TITLE-02.title: {{count}} more pages share this title.
TITLE-02.why: Pages with the same title compete in search; which one shows becomes unclear.
TITLE-02.how: Add a property that sets the page apart (colour, size, material).

TITLE-03.title: The title has {{problem}}.
TITLE-03.why: Shouting, repeated or symbol-heavy titles look untrustworthy and search engines may rewrite them.
TITLE-03.how: Write the title plainly, in normal case.

TITLE-04.title: The brand ({{brand}}) is not in the title.
TITLE-04.why: Shoppers searching for a brand click more on results that show it.
TITLE-04.how: Add the {marka} token to the title template or the brand to the SEO title.

META-01.title: The meta description is {{length}} characters; {{min}}–{{max}} is advised.
META-01.why: The description shows under the title in results; when short the search engine picks any text from the page, when long it is cut.
META-01.how: Write a description with the benefit and a price or shipping hint, or use the template.

META-02.title: {{count}} more pages share this description.
META-02.why: The same description makes pages hard to tell apart in results.
META-02.how: Make the description this page's own.

SLUG-01.title: The page address ({{slug}}) breaks the rules.
SLUG-01.why: Addresses use lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, up to 80 characters; otherwise they look broken when shared and searched.
SLUG-01.how: Make the address again from the name.

SLUG-02.title: The page address ({{slug}}) has none of the name's words.
SLUG-02.why: Meaningful words in the address tell shoppers and search engines what the page is.
SLUG-02.how: Make the address from the product's or page's name; the old one redirects on its own.

KW-01.title: The focus keyword "{{keyword}}" is missing from: {{missing}}.
KW-01.why: When the chosen word is in the title, the description and the start of the text, the page matches that search better.
KW-01.how: Add the word where it is missing, in a natural sentence.

ROBOTS-01.title: The page is closed to search engines (noindex).
ROBOTS-01.why: This page does not show in search; the other suggestions still help sharing and quality.
ROBOTS-01.how: If that is not intended, set the index choice in the SEO card to "by the page's state".

CONT-01.title: The text has {{words}} words; at least {{min}} is advised.
CONT-01.why: A short text does not answer shoppers' questions nor tell search engines enough about the page.
CONT-01.how: Add sections such as features, use, care and specifications.

CONT-03.title: Required attributes are empty: {{fields}}.
CONT-03.why: The attribute table informs comparing shoppers and filters; empty fields drop the product from lists.
CONT-03.how: Fill the missing fields in the attributes card.

CONT-04.title: The description has a main heading (H1).
CONT-04.why: The page's H1 is the product's name; a second one in the text blurs the page's subject.
CONT-04.how: Make the text's headings subheadings (H2, H3).

CONT-07.title: The description has an insecure (http) link or image.
CONT-07.why: http content on a secure page triggers browser warnings or does not load at all.
CONT-07.how: Change the links to start with https.

CONT-09.title: The short description is empty.
CONT-09.why: The short description shows under the product name, above the price, so a shopper knows it at a glance. Without an SEO description of its own, the search result’s description is taken from it too.
CONT-09.how: Introduce the product in a few sentences in the Short description card.

IMG-01.title: {{count}} images; at least {{target}} are advised.
IMG-01.why: Products without images do not show in Google Shopping nor in rich results; several angles build trust.
IMG-01.how: Add images showing the product from different angles.

DATA-01.title: {{count}} variants have no price.
DATA-01.why: A product without a price cannot be sold nor offered to search engines.
DATA-01.how: Enter each variant's price in the variants card.

DATA-02.title: {{count}} variants have no barcode (GTIN) nor brand + manufacturer code (MPN).
DATA-02.why: Google Shopping recognises products by these codes; without them the product matches less and shows less.
DATA-02.how: Enter a valid barcode for the variants; without one, add the brand and the manufacturer code.

DATA-03.title: The product has no brand.
DATA-03.why: The brand is what shoppers look for in structured data and results.
DATA-03.how: Pick a brand in the organise card.

DATA-04.title: No primary category is chosen.
DATA-04.why: The primary category sets the product's breadcrumb and its "back to category" link.
DATA-04.how: Make the deepest category primary in one click, or pick one in the catalog card.

DATA-05.title: No weight or dimensions entered.
DATA-05.why: Without them shipping is priced by the default parcel; the product's own make the price more accurate.
DATA-05.how: If you like, enter the weight and dimensions in the package card; publishing does not need them.

LINK-01.title: The product is in no category.
LINK-01.why: No link inside the shop leads to it; shoppers and search engines find it hard.
LINK-01.how: Pick at least one category in the organise card.

EMPTY-01.title: The page lists no live products.
EMPTY-01.why: An empty list disappoints visitors and search engines count it as thin content.
EMPTY-01.how: Add products, or close the page to search engines.

DEPTH-01.title: The category is at level {{depth}}; {{max}} at most is advised.
DEPTH-01.why: Deep structures sit far from the home page and are crawled less.

LOGO-01.title: The brand has no logo.
LOGO-01.why: A logo makes the brand recognisable on its page and when shared.
LOGO-01.how: Upload an image in the logo card.

IMG-02.why: Alt text tells people who cannot see an image, and image search, what it shows; without it the image does not appear in image search.
IMG-02.how: In the Images section, write a short description for each image: the product, its colour, the angle.

LEN-01.title: The text has {{words}} words; at least {{min}} is recommended.
LEN-01.why: Short pages do not answer the question fully; search engines and AI answers favour thorough content.
LEN-01.how: Expand the topic with examples, steps or frequently asked questions.

STRUCT-01.title: Weak structure: {{problem}}.
STRUCT-01.why: Question-style subheadings and paragraphs of 2–4 sentences read easily; search engines and AI answers quote sections one by one.
STRUCT-01.how: Split the text with question-style H2/H3 headings, break long paragraphs; use a list or table where it fits.

ANSWER-01.title: The opening has {{words}} words; a {{min}}–{{max}} word answer block is recommended.
ANSWER-01.why: A short section that answers the question on its own before the first heading is more likely to be quoted in AI answers and featured results.
ANSWER-01.how: Start the post with a {{min}}–{{max}} word introduction that sums up the topic.

INLINK-01.title: {{links}} internal links; at least {{min}} is recommended at this length.
INLINK-01.why: Links to products and categories take the reader to shopping and help search engines discover your pages.
INLINK-01.how: Link the products and categories the text mentions, or add their cards.

BYLINE-01.title: Author: {{problem}}.
BYLINE-01.why: A post by an author known by name, job title and biography builds trust; search engines want to see who wrote it and what their expertise is.
BYLINE-01.how: Choose an author from the list in the “Summary and author” card; add the author's photo, job title and biography under Content › Authors.

COVER-01.title: Images: {{problem}}.
COVER-01.why: Images support the text and are found in image search; alt text describes them to screen readers and search engines.
COVER-01.how: Add a cover image and write what each image shows in its alt text.

STALE-01.title: The text has not been updated for {{days}} days.
STALE-01.why: Content kept up to date looks more trustworthy to readers and search engines.
STALE-01.how: Review the facts; update products, prices and dates.

TEXT-01.title: The page's text is {{words}} words; at least {{min}} is suggested.
TEXT-01.why: A filter page earns its place by what it adds to the product list; a short text makes it a copy of the list.
TEXT-01.how: Add buying advice, comparisons and common questions specific to this category and filter.

UNIQ-01.title: Only {{originality}}% of the text is this page's own; at least {{min}}% is recommended.
UNIQ-01.why: Programmatic pages that resemble each other fall under Google's scaled content policy; a page must be valuable on its own.
UNIQ-01.how: Write facts, comparisons and advice specific to this category and filter; do not repeat other pages' text.

PRODUCTS-01.title: The page lists {{products}} products; at least {{min}} is recommended.
PRODUCTS-01.why: A filter page with very few products offers little choice and counts as thin content.
PRODUCTS-01.how: Add products that match this filter, or keep the page out of search.

BATCH-01.title: {{count}} filter pages went live in the last {{days}} days; at most {{max}} is recommended.
BATCH-01.why: Publishing many programmatic pages at once looks like spam to search engines.
BATCH-01.how: Publish pages in batches of 50–100, two weeks apart.

REVIEW-01.title: Only {{share}}% of the latest batch was reviewed by a person; at least {{min}}% is recommended.
REVIEW-01.why: Human review catches mistakes and repetition in programmatic pages.
REVIEW-01.how: Read the page and mark it "Reviewed by a person".

S-HOST-01.title: The store is not ready for search engines
S-HOST-01.why: Without a primary domain, pages have no canonical address and there is no sitemap; an environment closed to search engines is never indexed.

S-ROBOTS-01.title: robots.txt blocks search engines
S-ROBOTS-01.why: One rule in robots.txt can drop every product or category page from search results. The Sitemap line shows crawlers where the list of pages is.

S-SITEMAP-01.title: The sitemap is out of date
S-SITEMAP-01.why: Search engines learn about new and changed pages from the sitemap first; an old or partial one means new products show up late.

S-404-01.why: Addresses visitors and search engines asked for many times, this week too, but cannot find cost sales and rankings. A 301 to the suggested page carries the address's value over.

S-DUP-01.title_one: {{amount}} title or description is the same on several pages
S-DUP-01.title_other: {{amount}} titles or descriptions are the same on several pages
S-DUP-01.why: Pages showing the same title compete with each other in search results and tell searchers nothing apart. Titles from the template count too: give pages a distinct name or their own title.

S-ORPHAN-01.title_one: {{amount}} live product is in no category
S-ORPHAN-01.title_other: {{amount}} live products are in no category
S-ORPHAN-01.why: Nothing in the store links to a product without a category; search engines find it late and rate it low. Add it to at least one category.

S-REDIR-01.why: A rule whose target is missing or removed sends visitors to an empty page; a rule under a live page never runs; a rule whose target redirects again is out of date. Rules unused for a year can go; records with many old addresses carry a redirect for each.

S-IMG-01.title_one: {{amount}} product image has no alt text
S-IMG-01.title_other: {{amount}} product images have no alt text
S-IMG-01.why: An image without alt text is blank to image search and screen readers. Add it in the product page's Images section.

S-GSC-01.title_one: Search Console sees trouble on {{amount}} page
S-GSC-01.title_other: Search Console sees trouble on {{amount}} pages
S-GSC-01.why: Sitemap pages Google has not indexed never show in search results. A page whose clicks fall fast is losing rank or interest. A page shown often but rarely clicked has a title and description that do not draw searchers in.

S-CWV-01.title: Pages are slow for real visitors
S-CWV-01.why: Google uses the speed and stability Chrome's users measure (Core Web Vitals) in ranking. Values are the 75th percentile of the last 28 days; the good lines are LCP 2.5 s, INP 200 ms, CLS 0.1.

S-SEARCH-01.title_one: {{amount}} term is searched and not found
S-SEARCH-01.title_other: {{amount}} terms are searched and not found
S-SEARCH-01.why: Terms shoppers often search on the storefront and find nothing for; a product, category or content page for them, or a page's focus keyword updated, can turn them into sales.

S-ROBOTS-01.facets_open: A filtered or sorted listing is open to crawlers; their budget goes on thousands of combinations. Add the {facet_disallow} line to the robots.txt template.
