paymentLinkPaid.title: Payment link {{number}} was paid
paymentLinkPaid.description: The order was placed; click to open it.

paymentLinkPrices.title: Payment link {{number}}: prices changed
paymentLinkPrices.description: The customer could not pay. Create a new link at today's prices.

paymentLinkStock.title: Payment link {{number}}: a product is out of stock
paymentLinkStock.description: The customer could not pay. Update the stock, or cancel the link and create a new one.

paymentLinkOrdered.title: Payment link {{number}}: order placed
paymentLinkOrdered.description: Payment is taken at the door; the order is in Orders.

paymentLinkReview.title: Payment link {{number}}: check the order
paymentLinkReview.description: An unexpected order came from this link. Check whether the link was paid twice.

stockShort.title: Order #{{number}} is short of stock
stockShort.description: Missing: {{lines}}. Make or source them; if you cannot, cancel and refund.

completion_stuck.title: A {{provider}} payment cannot become an order
completion_stuck.description: No order opened for {{amount}} ({{reference}}, cart {{cart}}); it is still being tried and was not refunded. Check the stock and warehouse settings; if it cannot open, refund it in the provider's panel.

refunded_before_order.title: A refunded {{provider}} payment was not made an order
refunded_before_order.description: {{amount}} ({{reference}}, cart {{cart}}) shows as refunded in the provider's panel; no order was opened.

shelf_restored.title: A temporary stock raise was taken back
shelf_restored.description: The stock raised for cart {{cart}} was lowered again after the run stopped halfway. Check the stock counts.

wholesale_price_check.title: A wholesale cart's payment could not start
wholesale_price_check.description: Cart {{cart}} could not be brought to the wholesaler's prices of today; no payment was taken. Check the wholesale and retail prices of its products.

payment_beside_order.title: A second {{provider}} payment for a cart already ordered
payment_beside_order.description: {{amount}} ({{reference}}, cart {{cart}}) was taken for a cart whose order another payment opened; it was not refunded automatically. Check whether the customer paid twice; if so, refund the extra in the provider's panel.

refund_incomplete.title: A {{provider}} refund was made, its record is incomplete
refund_incomplete.description: The {{amount}} refund ({{reference}}) for order {{cart}} was, or may have been, made at {{provider}}, but its record could not be completed. It is checked automatically; if it is still incomplete in an hour, check {{provider}}'s panel. Do not make the same refund again.

refund_unresolved.title: A refund could not be confirmed for an hour
refund_unresolved.description: The record of the {{amount}} refund ({{reference}}, {{provider}}) for order {{cart}} could not be completed by the automatic check. Compare the refund on the order page with the payment provider's record; do not make the same refund again.

cancel_refund_order_open.title: A cancel's refund was made but the order is not canceled
cancel_refund_order_open.description: The {{amount}} cancel refund ({{reference}}, {{provider}}) for order {{cart}} was made, but the order is still open. Cancel the order; do not ship it.

page.description: Alerts from your shop; the unread ones are counted on the bell.

bankTransfer.title: Bank transfer awaited: #{{number}}
bankTransfer.description: Confirm the order once the {{total}} payment arrives.

content.description: The shop's own pages (about us, FAQ), blog posts, the blog's categories and tags, and filter pages.

empty.page: No pages yet. Write pages such as about us or frequently asked questions here.
empty.post: No blog posts yet. Add a first post about your products.
empty.landing: No filter pages yet. Give a category with a brand or attribute option a page of its own, with its own address and text.

content.addHint: Enter the title; you edit the text, cover and search appearance on its page next. It stays a draft until you publish it.

legal.title: Legal texts are not written here
legal.text: Contracts, the KVKK and cookie notices, the return and shipping policies are made from your shop's details under Settings > Legal and published at their own addresses. Written here as well, two versions of the same text would be live.

content.handleHint: Changing a live page's address redirects the old one to the new one.
content.excerptHint: Shown in lists and search results; the start of the text is used when empty.
content.authorHint: Who wrote the post: shown at its top and in the author box at its end, linked to the author's page; it builds trust with readers and search engines.
content.bodyHint: Write with headings, lists, tables, images and product or category cards.
content.coverHint: Shown in lists and when shared on social media.
content.coverAltHint: Briefly describe what the image shows.
content.deleteLive: The page is deleted for good; its address answers "gone" (410).
content.deleteDraft: The draft is deleted for good; another page may use its address.

link.title: Link
link.hint: Enter the path of a page on the shop (/kategori/kupa) or an address starting with http(s).
link.invalid: Enter a valid path or http(s) address.
link.invalidShort: Enter a valid path or https address.
link.hintShort: Enter the path of a page on the shop (/kategori/kupa) or an address starting with https.

image.title: Insert image
image.hint: Choose the image from the library, upload it from your computer or bring it in from an address; its metadata is removed on upload.
image.altHint: Briefly describe what the image shows; screen readers and search engines read it.

card.hint: The card shows the product's or category's current name and link on the shop.

landing.addHint: The category and filter are fixed once the page is made. You write its text and search appearance on its page next; a text specific to this page helps it stand out in search.

gone.category: The page's category was deleted; the page has no address and its old one answers 410. Move the text to a new page and delete this one.
gone.facet: The page's filter value no longer exists; the page cannot list products. Consider taking it down or deleting it.

landing.bodyHint: Write a text specific to this category and filter; do not repeat other filter pages' text.
landing.standingHint: Programmatic pages must be worth reading on their own.
landing.originalityHint: The share of the text not found on other filter pages. Under {{warn}}% search engines may take the page for a copy of the others; under {{low}}% it stays live but is kept out of search engines.
landing.keptOut: The page is live, but kept out of search engines until it is more original.
landing.reviewedHint: A person read the page through and approved it. At least 5% of newly published pages should be reviewed.

content.previewReady: The preview opened in a new tab; its link is copied and works for 24 hours.

empty.category: No blog categories yet. Add one above to group your posts by topic.
empty.tag: No tags yet. Add them above or from a post's page.

terms.addressHint: The address is made from the name you type.
terms.handleHint: If an archive with live posts gets a new address, the old one redirects to it.
terms.descriptionHint: Shown at the top of the archive page and in search results; when empty, the latest posts' titles are used.
terms.rankHint: Lower numbers come first; equal ones are sorted by name.

deleteText.category_one: The category's {{count}} post is not deleted; it becomes uncategorised. If the archive page showed live posts, its address answers “gone” (410). Its search appearance settings are deleted too.
deleteText.category_other: The category's {{count}} posts are not deleted; they become uncategorised. If the archive page showed live posts, its address answers “gone” (410). Its search appearance settings are deleted too.
deleteText.tag_one: The tag is taken off {{count}} post; the post is not deleted. If the archive page showed live posts, its address answers “gone” (410). Its search appearance settings are deleted too.
deleteText.tag_other: The tag is taken off {{count}} posts; the posts are not deleted. If the archive page showed live posts, its address answers “gone” (410). Its search appearance settings are deleted too.

terms.cardHint: The post is also listed on its category's and tags' pages on the blog.
terms.searchTag: Search tags or type a new name
terms.tagsFull: A post can have at most {{max}} tags.

authors.empty: No authors yet. Add an author once; each gets an author page on the blog and is chosen from the list on your posts.
authors.photoHint: Shown on the author page and in the author box at the end of posts; a square portrait works best.
authors.handleHint: Left empty, it comes from the name. Changing the address of an author with live posts redirects the old address to the new one.
authors.bioHint: Shown on the author page and at the end of posts; search engines learn who the author is from it. A blank line starts a new paragraph.
authors.linksHint: The author's own profiles; they tell search engines it is the same person.
authors.userHint: If the author is on the shop's staff, choose their account; optional.
authors.deleteText_one: The author's {{count}} post is kept, without an author. If the author page showed live posts, its address answers “gone” (410).
authors.deleteText_other: The author's {{count}} posts are kept, without an author. If the author page showed live posts, its address answers “gone” (410).
authors.unlinked_one: {{count}} post is now without an author.
authors.unlinked_other: {{count}} posts are now without an author.
authors.legacy: Old author name: {{name}}. Choose from the list or
authors.legacyAdd: add it as a new author

listingDescription.title: Description
listingDescription.hint: Shown at the bottom of the page on the storefront, after the products. Headings and paragraphs you paste from elsewhere are kept; Theme settings > Listing text sets how it looks.

postDraft.title: Post draft
postDraft.description: The AI writes a draft with headings from the post's title, focus keyword and summary. Read it before using it; nothing changes until you press Save.
postDraft.replaceWarning: This draft takes the place of the text now in the editor. Leaving without saving, or Undo, brings the old text back.
postDraft.linksHint: The draft puts no links in the text. Copy a link, select the words in the text and add it with the link button.
postDraft.copyFailed: Could not copy; type the link yourself: {{path}}

priceLists.description: Sale prices show the product's own price struck through; special prices go to the customer groups you choose.
priceLists.title: Price list
priceLists.created: Price list created. You can add products now.
priceLists.deleteDescription: Its prices are deleted too; products sell at their own prices. This cannot be undone.

types.saleHint: Customers see the product's own price struck through and this one as the sale price.
types.overrideHint: Replaces the product's own price, not shown as a sale. For trade or wholesale prices.

form.title: Name
form.titleHint: Only you see it: Summer sale, Trade prices.
form.whenHint: Without dates the list runs until you pause it.
form.activeHint: Off saves it as a draft.
form.startsHint: From the start of the day (Turkey time).
form.endsHint: Until the end of the day.
form.productsAfter: You add products and prices once the list is saved.

errors.title: Enter a name of 1 to 100 characters.
errors.description: The description can be at most 500 characters.
errors.dates: The end day cannot be before the start.
errors.groups: Choose at least one customer group.
errors.percent: Enter a rate above zero and at most 99.

lines.title: Products and prices
lines.hint: Type a price on its row, or take a percentage off the products' own prices.
lines.empty: No products in the list yet.
lines.overlapTitle: Some products are in another price list too
lines.overlapHint: Where lists' dates meet, a sale gives the lowest price and a special price the first list found.

discount.hint: Each variant is written into the list at its own price less this rate. A variant the list already prices gets the new price.
discount.skipped_one: {{count}} variant has no price of its own and was left out.
discount.skipped_other: {{count}} variants have no price of their own and were left out.

giftCards.description: The gift cards you give out and what each has left. Customers use the code in their basket; what is left carries to the next purchase.
giftCards.newHint: The code is made for you; give or send the card to the customer. Cards do not expire; they can be used until nothing is left.
giftCards.noteHint: Only you see it: who it is for and why.
giftCards.made: A card worth {{amount}} was made. Copy the code and give it to the customer.
giftCards.copyFailed: The code could not be copied; select it and copy it by hand.
giftCards.off: Gift cards are off. Turn them on to give customers gift cards and store credit.

errors.value: Enter an amount of at least 1.

close.title: Close card
close.description: The {{amount}} left on card {{code}} goes to zero and the card can no longer be used. The movement stays in the card's balance history; this cannot be undone.
close.reasonHint: E.g. the order was refunded. Written in the movement's note.
close.done: Card closed; the {{amount}} left went to zero.
close.empty: Nothing was left on the card; nothing changed.

giftCards.search: Search by code (whole or its start)
giftCards.limited: This view looks at the newest 5,000 cards; older ones are not listed.

storeCredit.title: Store credit
storeCredit.hint: A balance the customer can spend at checkout. Added for a refund or as a gesture; every addition is recorded.

reviews.title: Reviews and questions
reviews.description: Reviews from customers who received the product. A review you approve shows on the storefront and in the stars on search results.

reply.label: Your reply
reply.hint: Plain text. Shown under the review on the storefront as “Shop's reply”, with your shop's name.
reply.placeholder: E.g. Thank you for your review…
reply.tooLong: A reply can be at most {{max}} characters. Shorten it a little.
reply.sent: The reply is live on the storefront.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete the reply?
deleteConfirm.description: The reply leaves the storefront; the review stays.

reviews.changed_one: {{count}} review was changed by its author while you read it; read it again and decide.
reviews.changed_other: {{count}} reviews were changed by their authors while you read them; read them again and decide.

empty.unreplied: No approved review is waiting for a reply.

questions.description: Customers' questions about products. An answer in the shop's name shows at once; answers from customers who received the product wait for you.
questions.answerPlaceholder: Your answer in the shop's name (at least 10 characters)

empty.pending: No questions or answers to look at.

google.title: Google reviews
google.pageDescription: The reviews on your Google Business Profile are read every day and shown on the storefront's reviews page with Google's rating and link, apart from your own reviews.
google.description: Your business profile's rating, review count and newest reviews appear on the storefront under Google's name. The reviews are Google's; they are not edited here.
google.notConfigured: The Google connection is not set up for this shop yet.
google.notConnected: Connect with the Google account that owns or manages your business profile. You allow it on Google's own screen; your password is not shared with us.
google.notGranted: Your Google account is connected, but without Business Profile access. Allow it too on Google's screen so we can read the reviews.
google.noLocations: This Google account manages no business profile. Connect again with the account that owns or manages it.
google.locationSaved: Location saved; the reviews were read from Google.
google.errorReconnect: The Google connection cannot read the reviews; connect again.
google.errorLost: The connected Google account no longer reaches this business profile; choose the location again or connect with the profile's owner.
google.errorLater: The last sync got no answer from Google; the storefront shows the reviews last read. It is tried again the next day.
google.synced: The reviews were read from Google.
google.syncFailed: No answer from Google; try again later.
google.removed: Google reviews removed from the storefront.

confirm.title: Remove Google reviews?
confirm.description: The Google reviews leave the storefront and the copies kept here are deleted. The reviews stay on Google. The Google account connection (Merchant Center, Search Console) stays.

google.listDescription: The reviews read from Google, newest first. Click a review to reply or take it off the storefront. A review can be taken off the storefront only for personal data, abuse or being off topic; Google's rating and count do not change.
google.empty: This location has no reviews on Google.
google.shownDone: The review is back on the storefront.
google.hiddenDone: The review is off the storefront.
google.hideTitle: Take the review off the storefront?
google.hideDescription: {{author}}'s review stays on Google; it is only left off the storefront. Choose the reason.
google.hideRule: A negative review cannot be taken off for its rating; only for one of these three reasons.
google.replyHint: Plain text. Shown under the review on Google and on the storefront as “The shop's reply”.
google.replyPlaceholder: E.g. Thank you for your review…
google.replyTooLong: Google takes at most {{max}} bytes; accented letters count as two. Shorten it a little.
google.replyPendingNote: Google is reviewing the reply; once approved it shows on the storefront too.
google.replyRejectedNote: Google did not publish this reply; you can edit it and send it again.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete the reply?
deleteConfirm.description: The reply is removed from Google and the storefront; the review stays.

google.shownLine: This review shows on the storefront's reviews page.

roleHints.owner: Everything: payment and integration accounts, API keys and the team included.
roleHints.admin: All of the shop's work and settings; accounts, keys and the team aside.
roleHints.operations: Prepares and ships orders, takes returns in, looks after stock and reviews; cannot change settings or move money.
roleHints.readonly: Sees everything and downloads reports; changes nothing.

noRole.title: Your account has no role
noRole.text: You have no role in this shop's panel, or you were removed from the team. Ask the shop's owner.

invite.title: Join the team
invite.subtitle: {{email}} was invited as {{role}}. Create your account.
invite.invalid: The link is not valid or has expired. Ask the shop's owner for a new invitation.
invite.wrongLogin: The account must use the invited e-mail address.
invite.passwordShort: The password must be at least 10 characters.

app.title: Set up two-step verification
app.text: Signing in to the shop's panel asks for a code from the authenticator app on your phone besides your password. Scan the code below with an app such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password.

codes.title: Keep your recovery codes
codes.text: When your phone is not at hand, sign in with one of these codes. They will not be shown again.

done.title: All set
done.text: For safety, sign out and sign in again with your password and the app's code.

setup.qr: QR code for the authenticator app
setup.manual: Cannot scan it? Type this key into the app:
setup.passwordHint: Asked so that only the account's owner can set this up.
setup.wrongPassword: The password is not right; try again.
setup.kept: I have kept the codes somewhere safe
setup.wrong: The code is not right; enter the app's current code.
setup.startFailed: Setup could not start. Try again; if it persists, sign out and in again.

codes.label: Recovery codes
codes.hint: Each code works once. Making new codes voids the old ones.

passwordRule.too_short: The password must be at least 10 characters.
passwordRule.too_long: The password can be at most 256 characters.
passwordRule.common: This password is too common and easy to guess. A sentence of a few words works well.
passwordRule.contains_email: The password must not contain your e-mail's name.
passwordRule.breached: This password appears in a known data breach; choose another.

reset.title: Forgot password
reset.subtitle: Enter your panel account's e-mail address; we will send a reset link.
reset.sent: If an account uses this address, a reset link was sent. It works for 15 minutes.
reset.newSubtitle: Set a new password for your panel account.
reset.changed: Your password changed. Sign in with the new one.
reset.expired: The link is not valid or has expired; ask for a new one.

reauth.title: Prove it is you
reauth.withCode: Enter the code from your authenticator app to go on.
reauth.withPassword: Enter your password to go on.
reauth.failed: The code is not right; try again.
reauth.failedPassword: The password is not right; try again.

rateLimited.toast: Too many requests, try again in a moment.
rateLimited.title: Too many requests

unavailable.title: The panel could not load
unavailable.text: Your details could not be read just now; try again in a moment.

restrictions.label: Age limit
restrictions.productHint: Sold to adults only; search engines are told, and it stays out of the feeds.
restrictions.categoryHint: This category, its children and every product in them are sold to adults only.

shopTokens.title: Insert a shop detail
shopTokens.hint: When it changes on the store profile, the detail in the text changes too.
shopTokens.ownHint: Filled with the customer's and order's details when it is sent.

menus.title: Menus
menus.description: The storefront's header menu, top links and footer columns. Links point at your categories, products and pages, so they never break when an address changes.
menus.listHint: By where they show on the storefront.

fallback.main: No main menu; the storefront shows your category tree in the header.
fallback.top: No top links; no link row shows above the menu.
fallback.footer: No columns; the storefront shows your categories and a help column in the footer.

menus.brokenCount_one: {{count}} link not shown on the storefront
menus.brokenCount_other: {{count}} links not shown on the storefront
menus.empty: For now the storefront shows your category tree in the header, and your categories and a help column in the footer. Add a menu to build your own.

new.title: Add menu
new.description: Choose where the menu shows on the storefront and give it a name; you add its links next.

hints.main: The header's menu; links can open a panel of links under them.
hints.top: The small links above the menu: About us, Contact and the like.
hints.footer: A column of links at the bottom of the page; there can be several.

editor.title: Menu name

titleHint.footer: Shown on the storefront as the column's heading.

linksHint.nested: Drag or use the arrows to order them. A link moved under the one above shows in that one's panel in the header.
linksHint.flat: Drag or use the arrows to order them.

empty.main: No links; the storefront shows your category tree in the header.
empty.top: No links; no link row shows above the menu.
empty.footer: No links; this column does not show on the storefront.

editor.limitNested: At most {{links}} links, each with at most {{children}} under it.
editor.invalid: Fix the marked fields before saving.
editor.delay: A saved menu shows on the storefront within a minute.
editor.deleteText: “{{title}}” and its links are deleted; the storefront acts as if you had no menu there. This cannot be undone.

row.label: Shown name for {{name}}
row.notLiveHint: The record is not live, so the link is hidden on the storefront.
row.notFoundHint: The record was deleted; the link is hidden on the storefront. Change its target or remove it.

picker.description: Choose where the link goes; its name and address come from the record and follow it when it changes.

url.addressHint: A page of your shop starts with / (/campaigns), another site with https://.
url.invalid: The address must be a shop page starting with / or a site starting with https://.
url.name: Shown name

errors.textInvalid: Contains a character that cannot be used.

menus.footerOrderHint: When the footer uses "Free layout", its menu blocks are tied to the footer menus by their place in this order (1st, 2nd, 3rd menu). Change the order and the footer changes which menu shows where too.

editor.title: Theme editor
editor.unsaved: The draft could not be saved; fix the marked fields or retry the save first.

revisions.title: Publication history
revisions.description: The last 20 publications are kept by themselves. Add one you want to keep for good to 'My saved looks'.
revisions.empty: Nothing published yet; publications show here after the first one.
revisions.confirmText: The draft's changes are replaced by this publication; the current draft is saved to 'My saved looks' automatically. Page texts return to how they were in it too. The storefront does not change until you publish.
revisions.confirmKeep: This publication is loaded into the draft. Page texts return to how they were in it too. The storefront does not change until you publish.
revisions.menusText: When this publication went live it changed the menus too. The menus come into the draft as well: publish it again and that day's menus replace today's.
revisions.skipMenus: Leave the menus out, keep today's

discard.title: Discard the draft's changes?
discard.text: The draft goes back to the design that is live (the default one if nothing was published). The current draft is saved to 'My saved looks' automatically.
discard.done: The draft is back to the live design.

preview.noHost: The preview needs your shop's address; enter your domain in the SEO settings.
preview.scaleHint: The storefront is drawn at the chosen device's width and scaled down to fit here.

missing.hidden: This section is hidden; it does not show in the preview.
missing.scheduled: This section is outside its dates; it does not show in the preview now.
missing.other_page: This section is on another page.
missing.timeout: The section was not found in the preview.
missing.incomplete: This section is still empty. Fill in its required fields and it will show in the preview.
missing.unsaved: Changes are not saved yet because another section has missing fields. Once they are filled in, this section will show in the preview too.
missing.empty: This section has nothing to show right now. It will show in the preview once your shop has content for it, such as products, reviews or posts.

preview.liveOff: Live preview is unavailable; the preview will reload after each save.
preview.elsewhere: The preview shows {{path}}; on this page the header and footer can be edited. Pick a page to go back.
preview.blocked: {{path}} does not open in the preview (a checkout, account or sign-in page).

publish.title: Publish the design?
publish.text: The draft's header, home page, product, category and content pages and footer go live together. The storefront shows them within a minute.
publish.done: Published; it shows on the storefront within a minute.

tree.label: The page's sections

empty.home: The home page has no sections; the storefront shows only the header and footer.
empty.product: No sections added to the product pages; the product's own details show.

tree.footerFull: The footer has every section it can take; each is added once.

row.offNote: {{capability}} is off, so this section is not shown on the storefront; it shows again once turned on.

description.home: It is added at the end of the home page; drag it or use its arrows to move it.
description.product: It is added on every product page, under the product's own details.
description.top: It is added on every category page, above the product grid.
description.bottom: It is added on every category page, below the product grid.
description.footer: Shown above the footer on every page but checkout; each section is added once, then drag to change their order.
description.pages: Added to this page, after its sections; then drag it or use the arrows to move it.

announcement_bar.name: Announcement bar
announcement_bar.description: A thin bar at the very top; several announcements show the first only, in turn or side by side.

hero.name: Hero
hero.description: The page's opening: a heading, a short text, up to two buttons and an optional image.

hero_slider.name: Hero slider
hero_slider.description: 2–6 slides shown in turn at the top of the page, each with a picture, a heading, a short line and a button.

banner.name: Image band
banner.description: 1–6 images, side by side on a wide screen, each with its own heading, line and one or two buttons.

strip_gallery.name: Slanted strips
strip_gallery.description: 2–8 pictures side by side as slanted strips; the one under the mouse widens. Each strip can be a product, a category, a collection, a brand or your own picture; you can write its words and link yourself if you like.

categories.name: Categories
categories.description: The categories you pick; with none, your top categories.

products.name: Product list
products.description: The newest products, or a category's, a collection's or ones you pick.

featured_product.name: Featured product
featured_product.description: One product you choose, up close: its pictures, headline facts and spec table.

brands.name: Brands
brands.description: The brands you pick; with none, all your brands.

google_rating.name: Google rating
google_rating.description: Your average rating and review count on Google, and if you like excerpts from recent 4–5 star reviews. Not shown on the storefront while Google reviews are not connected or there are none.

rich_text.name: Text
rich_text.description: A title and formatted text; product and category cards may be added.

trust_badges.name: Trust badges
trust_badges.description: Your promises such as fast shipping or easy returns, as a strip on the page.

help.name: Help box
help.description: A short call for help with the ways to reach you.

footer_newsletter.name: Newsletter
footer_newsletter.description: The e-mail sign-up box in the footer; removed, it does not show.

faq.name: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Questions and answers that open and close; shown on the page only.

related_products.name: Related products
related_products.description: Products from the product's category, a collection or ones you pick.

marquee.name: Scrolling strip
marquee.description: Short promises or a campaign, as a strip that slides sideways.

header_bar.name: Header
header_bar.description: Your shop's name, search, account and cart, at the top of every page. The logo and menus are edited on their own screens.

footer_bar.name: Footer
footer_bar.description: Your contact details, menus, social accounts and payment marks, at the bottom of every page. Menus, contact details and social account addresses are edited on their own screens.

product_main.name: The product's own details
product_main.description: Photos, price, options and add to cart, on every product page. The content comes from the product's own record.

category_main.name: Product grid
category_main.description: The category's products, filters and sorting, on every category page. The other sections sit above or below it.

price_bands.name: Price bands
price_bands.description: 2–4 cards by price range; each card filters the shop by its range and shows a few products in it.

article.name: Page text
article.description: The page's own text; an outline beside a long one, collapsible questions in a Q&A text.

contact.name: Contact
contact.description: Text and ways to reach you beside the contact form, the shop's imprint below.

payment_facts.name: Payment options
payment_facts.description: The shop's payment methods and instalment table, kept current.

shipping_facts.name: Shipping details
shipping_facts.description: Carriers, the free shipping threshold and delivery times, kept current.

stats.name: Figures strip
stats.description: 2–6 figures about your shop: the value large, its label under it and an optional short line (e.g. 20 years, 10,000+ customers).

steps.name: Numbered steps
steps.description: 3–6 steps of a process in order, numbered: a title, a short intro and an optional single link under them.

photo_collage.name: Photo collage
photo_collage.description: 3–7 photos together: the first large or all even; optionally a title, an intro and a caption and link per photo.

variants.kept: The saved layout is being prepared; until it is ready, the storefront draws the standard one.

look.title: More settings
look.hint: A field left unpicked uses the theme's own look; the preview shows it at once.

spacing.title: Spacing
spacing.hint: The space above and below the section. A side left unset uses the theme's section spacing (Theme settings > Section spacing); a thin strip uses the narrow one.

space_outer.label: Top spacing
space_outer.hint: The space above the section, from the theme's section spacing; it shrinks on narrow screens.

space_below.label: Bottom spacing
space_below.hint: The space below the section; it stands in for the next section's top spacing, and with both set the larger stays.

space_inner.label: Inner spacing
space_inner.hint: The space inside the section, top and bottom alike, on the section spacing's scale; with a background it stays inside the colour.

ground.label: Background
ground.hint: The colour pairs are measured in the theme; text and button colours follow the background.

align.label: Alignment
align.hint: The section's heading and the text under it.

width.label: Width
width.hint: Narrow: a reading width. Boxed: the page's width. Full: edge to edge on a wide screen.

panel.visibleHint: A hidden section does not show; its settings are kept.
panel.scheduleHint: Give dates for a section shown for a while, such as a campaign; empty, it always shows.
panel.variantHint: How the section looks on the storefront; the preview shows it at once. Shared content (title, text) stays when the layout changes, and "Undo" brings the previous one back.

device.label: Device
device.hint: Phones: screens narrower than 1024 pixels (tablets included). Where it is hidden its pictures are not downloaded; the page's first picture still is.

tabs.label: Settings tabs
tabs.marked: some settings are off their defaults

defaults.heading: Your shop's name
defaults.helpText: Write to us about a product, an order or shipping; we will get back soon.
defaults.newsletterText: The storefront's text: hear about campaigns and news by e-mail…

fields.heading: Heading
fields.title: Title
fields.titleHint: Left empty, the storefront uses its own title.
fields.titleOptional: Optional; left empty, no title shows.
fields.textHint: Left empty, the storefront uses its own text.
fields.altHint: For visitors who cannot see it and for search engines: say briefly what it shows.

columnsHint.3: 3 products side by side on a wide screen, two rows ({{total}} products); 2 on a phone.
columnsHint.4: 4 products side by side on a wide screen, two rows ({{total}} products); 3 on a tablet, 2 on a phone.
columnsHint.5: 5 products side by side on a wide screen, two rows ({{total}} products); 4 and 3 on narrower screens, 2 on a phone.

fields.columnsShort: The storefront shows full rows only: set the number to show to at least {{total}} for two full rows.
fields.columnsMobileHint: How many products side by side on a phone; in one column the cards grow and three show.

hero.headingHint: Left empty, your shop's name shows.
hero.textPlaceholder: Orders ship the same day; returns are free within 14 days.
hero.buttonsHint: Up to {{max}} buttons; the first is the main one. With none, your first two categories show.
hero.imageHint: A wide, landscape image works best.

banner.empty: No images yet. The section is saved once it has one.
banner.hint: Up to {{max}} images, side by side on a wide screen.
banner.secondLinkHint: Optional; drawn one step quieter than the first.
banner.mobileImageHint: Optional. Shown instead of the wide image on screens narrower than 640 px.

tone.label: Text colour
tone.hint: Pick by the picture: light text on a dark one, dark text on a light one. The text stays readable at every setting.

width.label: Width
width.hint: Boxed: the page's width, rounded corners. Full: edge to edge.

overlay.label: Overlay strength
overlay.hint: The overlay keeps the text readable; the stronger, the more of the picture it covers. With none the text stands on its own plate.

button_style.label: Button style
button_style.hint: A second button is drawn one step quieter.

banner.splitFirst: The split band shows the first picture only; the others return when the variant changes.

edge.label: Edge
edge.hint: Where the picture meets the panel.

products.daysHint: The best sellers of the last so many days ({{min}}–{{max}}). Paid orders count, cancellations and returns are taken off. With too few sales the list is made up with the newest products.
products.onSaleHint: The products on the campaigns page, the deepest discount first. While nothing is on sale the section does not show in the storefront.
products.moreHint: The link under the list; removed, it does not show.
products.cardVariantHint: The style of this rail's cards. The framed card's settings come from Theme > Framed card.

records.pickMany: Click to add or take out; you can reorder them afterwards.
records.pickOne: Search by name and pick one.
records.categoriesEmpty: With none chosen, the storefront shows your top categories.
records.brandsEmpty: With none chosen, the storefront shows all your brands.

richText.description: What you write is saved to the draft by itself; you can add product and category cards and shop details.
richText.imageHint: From the media library; on phones it shows above the text.
richText.imageSideHint: The side the image stands on wide screens; on phones it is always on top.

help.contact: The ways to reach you (phone, e-mail, WhatsApp) come from the store profile; with none, the box does not show.

newsletter.descriptionPlaceholder: New products, offers and news in your inbox.
newsletter.descriptionHint: The short line under the heading; it tells visitors why to subscribe. Left empty, the storefront uses its own.
newsletter.showNoteHint: A small promise under the description (how often you write, that leaving is easy). Turned off, it does not show.
newsletter.notePlaceholder: A few e-mails a month · Leave any time
newsletter.noteHint: Write a promise you can keep. Left empty, the storefront uses its own.
newsletter.imageHint: A picture from the media library, on the card's left. Without one the box is drawn as the side-by-side band.
newsletter.consentHint: The sentence beside the subscription consent box: ticking it, the visitor agrees to commercial messages. It is not a description; it should name your shop and say a confirmation link will be sent. Left empty, the storefront's legal sentence is used.
newsletter.joinedHint: On: the band is drawn on the Free rows footer's own ground, as its top strip. Off: it stands above the footer as a box of its own. The other footer variants draw the band inside them anyway.

announcement.hint: Up to {{max}} lines of up to {{length}} characters each.

mode.label: Several announcements
mode.hint: Side by side: all on one line on a wide screen, the first only on a phone. In turn: with reduced motion the first one stays.

interval.label: Interval
interval.hint: How long each announcement stays: 8, 6 or 4 seconds.

pause_button.label: Pause button
pause_button.hint: It cannot be removed (accessibility); touch screens always show it.

hover_pause.label: Pause on hover
hover_pause.hint: It always stops when the keyboard reaches the bar.

align.label: Alignment
align.hint: Automatic: centred on a phone, on the left on a wide screen. On a wide screen the links and phone stay at the right end; centred, the announcement stands in the middle of the bar and moves just left of the links if they would reach it.

size.label: Size
size.hint: The bar's height and text size together: 32, 36 or 44 pixels.

problems.required: Write this line or remove it.
problems.textInvalid: The text cannot hold invisible control characters.
problems.tokenUnknown: There is an unknown detail in braces; add details from the Insert detail menu.
problems.linkLabel: Enter the shown text of the address.
problems.daysRange: Enter at least 7 and at most {{max}} days.
problems.scheduleOrder: The end must come after the start.
problems.colorInvalid: The colour must be in #rrggbb form, e.g. #1e3a8a.
problems.colorDuplicate: This colour name is already in the list.
problems.thresholdRange: Enter a whole number from 1 to {{max}}.
problems.contrast: This colour does not read well enough with white text or on the page colour (3:1 at least). Pick a darker shade.
problems.wellContrast: This colour does not read well enough on the areas one shade darker than the page (the boxes links and outlined buttons stand on; 3:1 at least). Pick a darker shade.
problems.marqueeLimit: A page may show up to {{max}} scrolling strips (the header's counts on every page); remove one.
problems.bandsOrder: Upper bounds must rise; only the last band may have none.
problems.bandsLimit: The home page can have at most {{max}} price bands sections (hidden ones count too); remove one.
problems.footerRowsLimit: The footer takes one to {{max}} rows.
problems.footerBlocksLimit: Too many blocks: a column takes up to 6 and the footer up to 24; some block types can be added only once.
problems.footerColumnsMismatch: The row's columns do not match its layout.
problems.footerBlockInvalid: This block cannot be saved; check its fields.
problems.footerNewsletterTwice: The footer cannot show two newsletter forms; remove the newsletter block or the newsletter section.
problems.footerNewsletterBand: While the footer uses "Free layout", the newsletter section cannot use "In the footer"; pick another variant or use a newsletter block.

theme.title: Theme settings
theme.live: Theme settings are part of the draft: changes are saved with it, show in the preview and go live with Publish.
theme.primaryHint: Buttons, links and the focus ring. It must read with white text and on the page colour. Empty, the theme's wine tone is used. The announcement bar does not take it; it stays graphite.
theme.accentHint: The selected chip and tab, counts, and the light ground of notes. Empty, selected items are graphite and a note's ground is a light tone of the main colour. The sale red and stock colours do not change.
theme.backgroundHint: The light surfaces of the page, boxes and form fields change together. The dark graphite parts (the announcement bar, stages) stay as they are.

sampleParts.heading: New arrivals
sampleParts.facesNote: Not loaded in the panel: {{names}}. The sample draws it in a system font of the same kind; the real one shows on the storefront.
sampleParts.ownPrimary: The main colour is empty: the colour in the sample is the theme's wine tone.

theme.fontsHint: The storefront loads its fonts from its own server; nothing about visitors goes to third parties.
theme.heading: Headings

fontNotes.noLira: This font has no ₺ sign. Prices are drawn in the body font; a ₺ you type into a heading shows in a fallback font.
fontNotes.singleWeight: It has one weight: headings are drawn regular, not bold.

theme.radiusHint: Boxes, pictures and inner corners. Soft is Grafit's 20 / 14 / 10 px; Gentle brings them to 16 / 11 / 8 px, Crisp to 12 / 8 / 6 px, Sharp to 4 / 3 / 2 px, Round makes them 30 / 21 / 15 px.
theme.buttonsHint: Buttons, the search field, form fields and the quantity stepper change together. Chips and counts are always pills.
theme.sectionSpacingHint: The space between the page's sections, changing for every section together. Normal is the theme's own gap (96 px on a wide screen); Compact brings it to 53 px, Tight to 34 px, Roomy to 115 px. A section's room inside its background comes from the same scale.
theme.surfaceStyleHint: The product page's info boxes, the category page's filters and subcategories, the cart's boxes. Filled is a tone darker than the page; Lined is a 1 px rule on the page's ground.
theme.spacingWords: spacing gap space tight compact roomy airy density

menu_style.label: Menu style
menu_style.hint: How a desktop menu item looks when pointed at or open: the header's menu, the dropdown and the list menu. Filled is each header layout's drawing today. The phone's menu stays the same.

shadow.label: Shadow
shadow.hint: Surfaces that open or float over the page: dropdown menus, drawers, dialogs, the phone's sticky buy bar and floating buttons. With None the shadow goes; a surface with no edge of its own gets a 1 px rule.

chip_style.label: Chip style
chip_style.hint: Unselected chips, tabs, option buttons and page numbers. A selected chip stays filled with the highlight colour in both styles.

media_ground.label: Photo background
media_ground.hint: Behind product and category photos, list thumbnails included. Light tone is a tone darker than the page; Page is the page's own ground.

density.label: Density
density.hint: The room between a section's heading and its content, between a product grid's columns and rows, and above the footer change together; the space between sections is Section spacing's. Airy is the theme's own (on a wide screen 40 px under a heading, a 24 × 40 px grid, 64 px above the footer); Balanced brings them to 24 px, 20 × 28 px and 48 px, Compact to 16 px, 16 × 20 px and 32 px.

motion.label: Motion
motion.hint: Calm is the theme's own short transitions. Lively zooms a product card's photo slightly and lifts the card while pointed at, eases sections and products in as the page scrolls, fades images in as they load and presses buttons down a little. A visitor who asks for less motion sees none of it.

theme.ratioHint: The shape of the picture on product cards. Grafit draws a square (1:1).
theme.show_brandHint: The brand's name above the product's on the product card. Nothing shows for a product without a brand.
theme.show_ratingHint: Stars, the average and the number of reviews on the cards of products with approved reviews. Nothing shows for a product without reviews.
theme.no_reviewsHint: What stands where the stars go on a product without reviews. The link opens the reviews on the product page.
theme.sale_badgeHint: The discount (30%) in the photo's corner of a product on sale.
theme.low_stock_badgeHint: On a product running low; no number is shown. The compact card does not draw it.
theme.sold_out_badgeHint: On the photo of a product that has sold out.
theme.sold_out_rowHint: What stands in the price's place. None of them adds the product to the cart from the card; the link opens the stock alert form on the product page.
theme.quick_viewHint: A “Quick view” button on the card: the product opens in a dialog without leaving the page, and goes to the cart from there. The product link stays as it is.
theme.quick_view_triggerHint: Phones and the compact card always show the small icon; a narrow compact card with no room beside its name and price (two columns on a phone) draws none.
theme.quick_view_rating: Show the rating in the dialog
theme.quick_view_ratingHint: The product's stars and review count; hidden without reviews.
theme.quick_view_summary: Show the short description in the dialog
theme.quick_view_summaryHint: The product's short description; without one, the description's first paragraph.
theme.quick_view_quantity: Show the quantity field in the dialog
theme.quick_view_quantityHint: While off, the dialog adds one.

tourCard.title: Tour card
tourCard.words: tour trip card badge rating arrow length days nights per person price text over photo
tourCard.text_positionHint: Over the photo: the name and price stand on a dark fade at the photo's foot. Standard cards only.
tourCard.rating_badge: Show the rating as a badge on the photo
tourCard.rating_badgeHint: The stars and average show in a small badge at the photo's top left instead of under the name. A product without reviews gets none.
tourCard.arrow: Show an arrow at the card's bottom right
tourCard.arrowHint: For looks only; the whole card still opens the product.
tourCard.duration_rowHint: A "5 days • 4 nights" row on a dated product, read from its Tour details' Length field; none when it is empty.

theme.cardVariantHint: The style of every product card in the shop. A product rail can pick its own; listing, search and category pages use this one.
theme.framedHint: Applies wherever a card is drawn framed: as the shop's style or on a rail set to framed.
theme.hover_imageHint: The product's second photo shows when the pointer is over the card; on a phone the photos of a large card swipe sideways. Applies to every card style; no effect on a product with one photo.
theme.delivery_noteHint: "Free shipping" under the price of a product whose price reaches the free shipping threshold. The threshold is set on the Promotions page.
theme.full_buttonHint: An "Add to cart" button at the card's foot; on a product with options "Options" opens its page. Off, the round + stays on the photo's corner.
theme.button_styleHint: The “Add to cart” and “Options” button at the card's foot. Outline fills with the main colour while the card is pointed at.

grafit.hint: Sets every field to the theme's default look (Grafit). The change goes into the draft; the storefront does not change until you publish.
grafit.done: Theme settings are back to Grafit.

theme.listingTextHint: The description at the bottom of category, brand and collection pages. Its face is the body face.

align.label: Alignment
align.hint: Text aligned to the start or centred.

width.label: Width
width.hint: Narrow: an easy reading measure. Wide: the page's content width.

collapse.label: Fold long text behind 'Read more'
collapse.hint: A long text shows its first lines, the rest opens with a button. The whole text stays in the page; search engines read all of it.

listingText.words: description text category brand collection read more fold

faq.question: Question {{number}}'s text
faq.hint: Up to {{max}} questions; answers may hold the shop's details.
faq.openFirstHint: The first answer shows when the page opens.
faq.singleOpen: One question open at a time
faq.singleOpenHint: Opening a question closes the one already open.

related.sameCategoryHint: Each product page shows other products from that product's category.

featured.hint: The pictures, headline facts, price and spec table come from the product's own page. While the product is not published the section does not show.

galleryHint.collage: One large photo on the left; on wide screens two small ones beside it.
galleryHint.strips: The photos side by side as slanted strips. On wide screens the strip under the mouse widens; on phones at most three, and they stay equal.

stripsLayoutHint.side: The strips on the left, the product's name and price on the right; up to four strips.
stripsLayoutHint.wide: The strips fill the section's whole width, the product's name and price under them; up to six strips. To run them from one edge of the screen to the other, set the width to “Full” under Look.

featured.stripsSlantHint: How far the lines between the strips lean.
featured.stripsLineHint: The space between the strips. With “None” the strips touch.
featured.stripsOverlapHint: Each strip lies over the one before it with a thin shadow on its edge; the one under the mouse comes to the top.
featured.stripsDimHint: On wide screens, while the mouse is over a strip or the keyboard selects one, the other strips darken.

empty.product: No live product by that name.
empty.category: No storefront category by that name.

missing.product: The preview needs a live product; publish one and the product page shows here.
missing.category: The preview needs a category shown on the storefront; activate one and its page shows here.

drawer.title: The page's sections
drawer.description: Pick a section to open its settings.

slider.slidesHint: {{min}}–{{max}} slides, shown in turn. Click a slide to edit it.
slider.empty: No slides yet. The section saves with at least {{min}} slides.

heightHint.compact: A low strip on wide screens; more of the sections below fit the first screen.
heightHint.regular: As tall as the hero; the picture leads on wide screens.

slider.imageHint: A landscape picture at least 1600 px wide. Phones show its middle, cropped.
slider.mobileImageHint: Optional. Shown instead of the wide one on screens narrower than 640 px.
slider.headingHint: Optional; the first slide's heading is the home page's main heading.
slider.textHint: A short line; not shown on phones.
slider.toneHint: A shade that suits the picture goes behind the words. On phones the words sit under the picture on a dark ground.

stripGallery.textHint: Optional; a short line under the heading.
stripGallery.itemsHint: {{min}}–{{max}} strips, left to right in this order. Click a strip to edit it.
stripGallery.empty: No strips yet. The section is saved with at least {{min}} strips.
stripGallery.full: At most {{max}} strips can be added.
stripGallery.kindHint: The picture, heading, line and link you leave empty come from the record you choose. Changing the source keeps what you wrote.
stripGallery.ownHint: All optional; a field you fill takes the place of the source's.

imageHint.product: Left empty, the product's picture is used. Upright or square pictures suit a strip best.
imageHint.category: Left empty, the category's picture is used. Upright or square pictures suit a strip best.
imageHint.collection: Left empty, the collection's picture is used. Upright or square pictures suit a strip best.
imageHint.brand: Left empty, the brand's picture is used. Upright or square pictures suit a strip best.
imageHint.custom: Required. Upright or square pictures suit a strip best.

stripGallery.title: Heading

titleHint.product: Left empty, the product's name is shown.
titleHint.category: Left empty, the category's name is shown.
titleHint.collection: Left empty, the collection's name is shown.
titleHint.brand: Left empty, the brand's name is shown.
titleHint.custom: Optional; left empty, the strip shows no heading.

noteHint.product: Left empty, the product's price is shown.
noteHint.category: Left empty, the number of products in the category is shown.
noteHint.collection: Optional; left empty, no line is shown.
noteHint.brand: Optional; left empty, no line is shown.
noteHint.custom: Optional; left empty, no line is shown.

linkHint.product: Left empty, the product's page opens.
linkHint.category: Left empty, the category's page opens.
linkHint.collection: Left empty, the collection's page opens.
linkHint.brand: Left empty, the brand's page opens.
linkHint.custom: Optional; left empty, the strip leads nowhere.

width.label: Width
width.hint: Full width strips run from one edge of the screen to the other; boxed ones stand at the page's width with rounded corners.

height.label: Height
height.hint: How tall the strips stand; a little shorter on phones.

captions.label: Words
captions.hint: Each strip's heading and line at its foot, or the pictures alone.

strips_slant.label: Slant
strips_slant.hint: How far the lines between the strips lean.

strips_line.label: Line thickness
strips_line.hint: The space between the strips. With “None” the strips touch.

strips_overlap.label: Overlap
strips_overlap.hint: Each strip lies over the one before it with a thin shadow on its edge; the one under the mouse comes to the top.

strips_dim.label: Darken the others
strips_dim.hint: On wide screens, while the mouse is over a strip or the keyboard selects one, the other strips darken.

googleRating.excerptsHint: Reviews you hid never show; only recent 4 and 5 star reviews with text.
googleRating.profileLinkHint: Beside the link to the reviews, your page on Google Maps opens in a new tab.
googleRating.source: The rating and count are Google's; the storefront never changes them. Connection and reviews:

badges.title: Trust badges
badges.description: Changes go to the draft; Publish puts them live.
badges.note: These badges look the same everywhere on the site: the product page, the cart, the shipping page.
badges.buyBox: The badges under the buy box are edited in the Trust badges section.
badges.tokens: With Insert detail ({}) you can add shop details such as the phone or the free shipping threshold; the text follows when they change.
badges.empty: No badges; the storefront shows no trust strip or assurances.

looks.title: Stock and colour swatches
looks.description: The “Az kaldı” (few left) note on product cards and the colour names shown as coloured circles. Changes go to the draft; Publish puts them live.

lowStock.title: Low stock badge
lowStock.enabled: Say “Az kaldı” on a product running low
lowStock.enabledHint: Shown on the product card; the number left is never shown.
lowStock.thresholdHint: Cards read the published threshold: a new one shows after publishing, not in the preview.

swatches.title: Colour swatches
swatches.description: A value that names one of these colours in product options, filters and on the product page shows as a coloured circle (e.g. Lacivert).
swatches.hint: At most {{max}} colours; each name at most {{length}} characters, written once.

preferences.title: Storefront preferences
preferences.description: How the shop works: the pages that show the contact form and the payment and shipping facts. These settings are not part of the draft: Save puts them live at once, without waiting for Publish. Maintenance mode is in Settings > Maintenance mode.

pendingMenus.text_one: The draft carries a restored version's menu: Publish replaces the shop's menu with it.
pendingMenus.text_other: The draft carries a restored version's {{count}} menus: Publish replaces the shop's menus with them.

marquee.hint: Up to {{max}} items; the strip slides them one after another.
marquee.full: This page already has {{max}} scrolling strips (the header's counts too).

size.label: Size
size.hint: Small: a thin line of text. Medium: with an icon and a second line. Large: a big campaign line.

hover_pause.label: Pause on hover
hover_pause.hint: When off it keeps moving under the pointer; it still stops when an item gets keyboard focus.

pause_button.label: Pause button
pause_button.hint: The button cannot be removed: some visitors need to stop moving text. It always shows on phones.

uppercase.label: Uppercase
uppercase.hint: Each item's main line is set in CAPITALS; the second line stays as written.

outline.label: Filled / outline text
outline.hint: Items alternate between filled and outlined letters. Large size only.

closable.label: Close button
closable.hint: Once a visitor closes it, the strip stays hidden in that browser; changing its text shows it again.

headerBar.stickyHint: The header stays at the top of the screen while the page scrolls. Off, it scrolls away with the page.

search_placeholder.label: Search box text
search_placeholder.hint: Left empty: “Search products, categories or brands”.

search_label.label: Written search button
search_label.hint: On: a filled “Search” button instead of the magnifier.

account_text.label: “My account” in the top strip
account_text.hint: The account icon always stays on the menu bar.

cart_total.label: Show the cart's total
cart_total.hint: With items in the cart, the subtotal shows beside its icon.

highlight_link.label: Highlighted link
highlight_link.hint: One standout link at the end of the main menu on the menu bar (e.g. Offers).

utility_bar.label: Top utility strip
utility_bar.hint: A thin light strip: a short note, the “Top menu” links from Menus (where they stand is chosen below) and My account. Hidden on phones.

strip_note.label: Strip note
strip_note.hint: A short announcement or offer. Shop details work too: free shipping over {ücretsiz_kargo_eşiği} (the note hides while no threshold is set).

strip_note_link.label: Note link
strip_note_link.hint: Pick one and the note becomes clickable. Leave it empty and it stays plain text.

phone.label: Phone number
phone.hint: The phone from your store details, right of the search under “Customer service”. Not shown without a phone.

categories_button.label: “Categories” button
categories_button.hint: At the start of the menu bar; top categories and their subcategories as a dropdown.

menu_images.label: Category pictures in the menu
menu_images.hint: Submenus: the list that opens on hover and the phone menu. Everywhere: the catalog header's “Kategoriler” list too. A category without a picture shows an empty square.

search_style.label: Search look
search_style.hint: Icon: a magnifier on wide screens that opens the search box. On a phone no header shows a box; the bottom bar's “Ara” drops the search down from the top.

menu_ground.label: Menu bar background
menu_ground.hint: Text and icon colours are picked to read on it.

search_width.label: Search box width
search_width.hint: Narrow: a short box right after the logo; the rest of the row is left to the phone number and the icons. With the search as an icon, the box opens this wide.

top_links.label: Where the top menu links stand
top_links.hint: The “Top menu” links from Menus. On the menu bar: plain words after the categories, under “More” when they do not fit. In the top strip: not in the header while the strip is off.

tools_place.label: Where the account, favourites and cart icons stand
tools_place.hint: In the logo row: the icons with their names right of the phone number, “My account” shown once. Phones stay as they are.

headerBar.phoneNote: On phones the header stays as it is: menu, logo, favourites and cart, with the search below (with the search as an icon there is no box; the bottom bar’s “Ara” opens it).

columns.label: Cards in a row
columns.hint: How many cards side by side on a wide screen; the theme shows fewer on narrow screens.

data_detail.minimax: MiniMax's international platform is used. Where data is processed and whether it trains models could not be verified from the service's documentation; we suggest reading MiniMax's own terms before connecting. Only content published on your storefront is sent.
data_detail.gemini: Under Google's terms, content sent on the free tier is used to improve Google's products and may be read by people at Google; on the paid tier (billing on) it is not. tasks.extraPlaceholder: e.g. Put the brand name last; give the size in the title.
tasks.examplesHint: Up to {{max}} examples, each {{length}} characters at most. Do not write customer names or details; an example is sent to the service with every request.

craft.title: Advanced
craft.hint: The task instruction tells the AI how to do this task. Your text replaces the default; the rules below are always added. Only the store owner can change it.
craft.label: Task instruction
craft.outdated: The default instruction was updated; see what changed.
craft.rulesHint: Whatever your instruction says, these are added at the start and the end: no made-up facts, and the form, length and answer rules stay.

try.title: Try
try.description: See what the guidance changes before you save it: two suggestions for the product you pick, side by side, one without guidance and one with the values above.
try.cost: Each try counts as two AI operations. The suggestions are not saved or written to the product.
try.refused: This suggestion did not pass the check; try again.

acceptance.title: Acceptance in the last {{days}} days
acceptance.hint: How many of the AI's suggestions you used. Suggestions that failed the check are not counted; this is where a change to the writing guidance shows.
acceptance.empty: No suggestions in the last 30 days.

picks.note: A suggestion you click is added to the field; saving is up to you.
